title: Responsable Sécurité Financière - LOD1 (F/H)
description:
Chez Younited, nous pensons que les services financiers devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Everyday financial services : Avec helios by Younited, nous proposons des solutions pour aider chacun à mieux gérer ses finances, tout en construisant notre future offre bancaire du quotidien.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, tu pilotes l’équipe Sécurité Financière de 1ère ligne de défense (LOD1), en charge du traitement des alertes LCB-FT et de screening.

Depuis 2024, Younited a engagé sa transformation pour devenir un acteur bancaire global. Dans ce contexte, tu joues un rôle clé dans la structuration et la fiabilisation du dispositif de sécurité financière, en garantissant la qualité des analyses, le respect des délais et des procédures, ainsi que la maîtrise des risques opérationnels.
 
À la croisée des enjeux opérationnels, réglementaires et managériaux, tu fais le lien entre les exigences de conformité et leur mise en œuvre concrète par les équipes. Tu contribues ainsi à renforcer les contrôles de 1er niveau, à fiabiliser le pilotage de l’activité et à accompagner l’évolution des outils et des pratiques.
 

Missions 🚀 

1) Opérations de sécurité financière (LOD1)
  • Superviser les entrées en relation et les diligences KYC (KYC renforcé, revues périodiques) avec escalade des profils les plus risqués à l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 pour validation
  • Garantir le traitement de 1er niveau des alertes de transaction et de filtrage (sanctions, gel des avoirs, PPE) et l'escalade des alertes documentée vers l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Piloter la gestion des comptes inactifs et le cycle de blocage, d'investigation et de clôture des comptes en lien avec l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Superviser les flux sensibles (virements sortants, recalls, chargebacks)
  • Exécuter les saisies et piloter le prestataire externe en charge des réquisitions judiciaires

2) Pilotage de l'activité

  • Piloter les SLA par flux et s’assurer de leur respect
  • Piloter le prestataire externe et suivre la qualité du traitement des réquisitions judiciaires
  • Être l'interlocuteur opérationnel de l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 sur les sujets LCB-FT

3) Contrôle, remédiation et transformation

  • Piloter la remédiation des recommandations d'audit et de contrôle jusqu'à leur clôture
  • Suivre les audits et le contrôle permanent et les plans d'action associés
  • Déployer le plan de contrôle de 1er niveau et renforcer les contrôles insuffisants et les actions correctrices
  • Rédiger et maintenir l’ensemble des procédures et modes opératoires du département
  • Former et accompagner l'équipe sur le traitement des alertes de surveillance des opérations et à la rédaction des examens renforcés
  • Faire évoluer les outils et automatiser les traitements, en accompagnant l'équipe dans le changement
  • Participer à la consolidation des données pour les comités des risques

4) Reporting réglementaire

  • Coordonner avec, l’équipe en charge de la LOD2, la production de données fiables et leur analyse, pour les reportings et les demandes des superviseurs
  • Structurer et automatiser les indicateurs de l'activité

5) Management

  • Encadrer l'équipe et la faire monter en compétences
  • Organiser l'activité selon les risques ; piloter les délais, les stocks et la qualité
  • Appuyer l'équipe sur les dossiers complexes et sensibles avant escalade

À propos de toi 👇

  • Tu as 7 ans d’expérience minimum en sécurité financière et fraude dans un établissement bancaire, une fintech ou un cabinet de conseil, dont une expérience en management d’équipe opérationnelle
  • Tu as une expérience concrète de structuration ou de refonte d’un dispositif opérationnel : procédures, contrôles de 1er niveau et outils
  • Tu as déjà piloté la remédiation de recommandations d’audit ou de contrôle
  • Tu sais traduire les exigences de conformité en pratiques opérationnelles claires
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance de la réglementation bancaire, notamment du contrôle interne, de la LCB-FT, du RGPD et de la DSP2
  • Tu es capable de conduire un projet transverse, de prioriser les actions et d’accompagner le changement
  • Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur d’analyse, de capacité de décision, de pédagogie et d’implication directe dans les travaux

Processus de recrutement 📅

  • Premier échange en visio avec Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, pour apprendre à se connaître, échanger autour de tes motivations et te présenter plus en détail Younited (30 min)
  • Second échange en visio avec Antoine, ton futur manager et directeur des opérations chez Younited pour parler des attendus du poste de manière plus approfondie (60 min)
  • Une étude de cas à restituer en physique pour évaluer tes compétences au travers d’une mise en situation appliquée à une problématique liée au poste (60 min)
  • Un dernier entretien en visio avec Rémi, ton futur N+2 et CEO France chez Younited, pour valider l’alignement global sur le poste et les évolutions possibles (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)

  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)

  • Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe

  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited

  • Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun

  • Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso

  • Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés

  • Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales

  • Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an

  • 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)

  • Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel 

  • Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur

  • Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe

Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

title: Material Flow Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

The Material Flow Engineer designs, builds, and optimizes the end-to-end physical movement and presentation of hardware from receiving docks through warehousing, kitting, and lineside delivery, to support high-rate production schedules and rapid manufacturing scale. This role owns the physical-to-digital operating mechanisms that translate factory layouts and inventory data into executable material handling workflows, including Plan for Every Part (PFEP) management, facility layout engineering, and custom material handling hardware design.

You will serve as the connective tissue between Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, driving inventory accuracy, eliminating lineside bottlenecks, and deploying low-CAPEX, high-impact floor solutions before scaling to automation. In addition to daily floor execution, you will partner closely with Design Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Facilities to support New Product Introduction (NPI) line readiness, factory expansions, and continuous lean process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Material Flow Design: Analyze, design, and optimize the receiving, storage, movement, and lineside presentation of all production and non-production materials to eliminate technician search and walk time.

  • Plan for Every Part (PFEP) & Data Ownership: Build, maintain, and own the PFEP database defining part dimensions, packaging specifications, containerization, storage media, replenishment triggers (Kanban/min-max), and delivery frequencies.

  • Factory & Warehouse Layout Engineering: Create conceptual and detailed 2D/3D facility layouts (AutoCAD/CAD) for warehouse racking, supermarket zones, tugger routes, and lineside staging to support scalable production rates.

  • Custom Hardware & Packaging Development: Design, procure, and deploy custom material handling equipment, including kitting carts, lineside racks, dunnage, and returnable packaging, to protect sensitive components and ensure seamless point-of-use presentation.

  • Constraint & Bottleneck Mitigation: Conduct daily Gemba walks, time studies, and root-cause analyses to proactively identify material flow bottlenecks, implement poka-yoke (error-proofing) workflows, and resolve floor constraints before they impact build schedules.

  • Cross-Functional & NPI Alignment: Represent material flow readiness in production, NPI, and operational review meetings. Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Operations Leadership to support new line launches, facility expansions, and engineering changes.

  • Performance & Data-Driven Optimization: Extract and analyze production, inventory, and cycle-time data using SQL and ERP/WMS systems to right-size buffer stock, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and drive down material handling costs.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Masters’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical/analytical discipline.

  • 2+ years of hands-on engineering experience in a fast-paced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, automotive, or high-volume production environment involving complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Just-In-Time (JIT), Kanban, Plan for Every Part (PFEP), and Six Sigma principles applied on an active production floor.

  • Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or equivalent) for facility layout engineering and custom cart/rack design.

  • Experience querying and analyzing operational and ERP/WMS data using SQL, Python, or advanced Excel to drive material flow and inventory decisions.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) line launches, greenfield facility buildouts, and production ramps.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills with a proven ability to influence production teams, engineering peers, and leadership on the shop floor.

  • Adaptable, hands-on problem solver willing to balance analytical modeling with immediate physical execution on the factory floor in a rapidly changing environment.

  • Ability to work 100% onsite and travel up to 20% as needed to supplier sites or sister manufacturing facilities.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Betrieb, Weiterentwicklung und Lifecycle‑Management der Microsoft PKI‑Infrastruktur (AD CS) sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen und sicheren Zertifikatsbetriebs

title: IT Systems Administrator
description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

We are seeking an IT Systems Administrator II to support and maintain our cloud, on-premises, and SaaS platforms. This role is responsible for the administration, security, automation, and optimization of enterprise infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft, and on-premises environments. The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders and software vendors to support business-critical applications, upgrades, integrations, and implementations while ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of underlying infrastructure and services. The ideal candidate has experience supporting enterprise infrastructure in a regulated environment and embraces an automation-first approach to systems administration, leveraging Infrastructure as Code, scripting, and modern IT operational practices.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, administer, maintain, and optimize infrastructure, services, and applications across AWS, SaaS, and on-premises environments.
  • Administer and support Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, DNS, DHCP, file services, identity management, and Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, PowerShell, or similar technologies 
  • Monitor system health, performance, security, and availability; investigate and troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cloud, identity, and application issues.
  • Implement and maintain security controls, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and least-privilege access practices.
  • Provide technical support for business-critical enterprise applications and collaborate with business stakeholders and software vendors to support operations, integrations, upgrades, and implementations.
  • Participate in change management activities and support application and infrastructure deployments, migrations, testing, upgrades, and production changes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to employees and junior IT staff.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressively responsible experience as a Systems Administrator, Cloud Administrator, Site Reliability Engineer, or similar role in a complex enterprise environment
  • Strong experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 services, identity management, and SSO integrations,
  • Working knowledge of Linux server administration in AWS and hybrid-cloud environments
  • Demonstrated experience administering AWS infrastructure, including services such as EC2, IAM, VPC, Route 53, Systems Manager, FSx, CloudWatch, and related AWS technologies 
  • Strong scripting and automation experience using PowerShell and AWS CLI 
  • Experience supporting SaaS, cloud-native, hybrid-cloud, and on-premises applications and infrastructure 
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred
  • 8+ years of overall IT experience is preferred
  • Terraform and Ansible experience is preferred
  • Nutanix AHV administration experience is preferred
  • Advanced Microsoft Windows Server and Active Directory administration experience is preferred
  • Experience supporting application integrations, APIs, SQL databases, and reporting platforms is preferred
  • Experience working with software vendors during upgrades, implementations, and troubleshooting efforts is preferred
  • Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, laboratory, or quality-focused organizations is preferred
  • Experience working in high-growth organizations undergoing technology transformation is preferred
  • Prior work experience in a fast-paced, high-growth startup is preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of networking, databases, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery concepts 
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, patch management, and security best practices 
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills 
  • Resourceful problem-solver with a service-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of cloud and hybrid infrastructure administration principles, including AWS, Microsoft, SaaS, and on-premises environments
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, scripting, and systems automation practices
  • Knowledge of identity and access management principles, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Single Sign-On, and least-privilege access
  • Ability to monitor and assess system health, performance, availability, and capacity across enterprise infrastructure and services
  • Knowledge of change management practices related to infrastructure and application deployments, migrations, upgrades, and production changes
  • Ability to support and coordinate application integrations, implementations, and upgrades across internal stakeholders and third-party vendors
  • Ability to develop and maintain technical standards, procedures, and system administration documentation
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to employees and less-experienced IT staff

Physical Demands

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods
  • Communicating with others to exchange information

Environmental Conditions

  • General office environment
  • Noisy environments
  • Prototyping/Test Facilities
  • Manufacturing/Industrial Environments

Travel

  • Some travel may be required, up to 5%

Additional Requirements

  • Occasionally requires working weekends
  • Occasionally requires extended hours to support system maintenance, deployments, upgrades, and critical incidents

The salary range for this position is $108,700 to $127,900 for employees working onsite at our Alameda, CA headquarters. The range provided in this job posting represents the typical range or starting rate of candidates hired in California. Factors that maybe used to determine your actual salary may include your education, experience, knowledge, skills, ability and the market data for your work location, and a comparison to other employees already in the role.

#LI-Remote

About our Benefits

We know that we have some of the most talented and dedicated employees, and we believe in rewarding them accordingly. If you work here, full-time employees (excludes interns) expect to have access to the benefits below:

  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Medical, dental and vision benefits for employees and their dependents
  • Paid Vacation
  • 401(k) and pre-tax health insurance, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA)

Kairos Power is committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities where we do business. Kairos Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We actively welcome people of different experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Kairos Power participates in E-Verify.

Candidates only, no recruiters or agencies please.

Note: You are applying for a position that is located in a facility that handles information that is subject to export control restrictions by the Department of Energy under 10 CFR Part 810. To work in this facility, you need to be authorized by the Department of Energy to access Part 810-controlled information. Foreign nationals who are citizens of countries that are not on the Department of Energy’s general authorization list (link below) are not permitted to work in our facility unless the Department of Energy issues an export control license to the company to permit that individual to have access to Part 810-controlled information. title: Solutions Consultant, Post Sales, Commercial
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Solutions Consultants, Post-Sales at Ramp partner with Account Management to deepen and expand relationships with existing Ramp customers. You'll act as the technical and financial subject matter expert across the customer lifecycle — running product demonstrations to expand customers onto new Ramp products, while bringing the depth needed to resolve complex ERP integrations, configuration challenges, and technical blockers.

You'll collaborate closely with Account Managers to assess requirements, design scalable solutions, and ensure fast time-to-value as customers grow with Ramp. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers. This role requires strong technical skills — comfort with APIs, ERP systems, and integration architecture — paired with the communication ability to translate complexity into clear business value for finance and operations stakeholders.

This role is focused on Commercial and Mid-Market customers, supporting high-growth companies with standardized financial workflows and core ERP integrations.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Account Managers to demonstrate new Ramp products and features to existing customers, building the business case for expansion through customized demos and workflow illustrations

  • Evaluate customer requirements for expansion opportunities, assessing fit through use-case analysis, ROI assessments, and technical scoping

  • Design and recommend best-fit Ramp architecture — including when and how to use APIs, ERP integrations, and HRIS connectors — based on each customer's existing systems and workflows

  • Act as a technical advisor to customers and internal teams, guiding integration, configuration, and system design decisions without writing code directly

  • Troubleshoot ERP and integration blockers, and guide customers through complex configuration decisions across NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle Fusion, and others

  • Support Account Managers on technical workstreams, ensuring faster time-to-value during product rollouts and expansions

  • Be a subject matter expert across accounting systems and integration partners; advocate for integration development in line with customer needs alongside Product and Partners

  • Influence Ramp's product roadmap by channeling customer pain points and feedback to Product and Engineering teams

  • Contribute to internal documentation, tooling, and knowledge bases that scale Ramp's ability to support integration use cases across a growing customer base

What You Need

  • 3+ years in Solutions Consulting, Technical Consulting, Implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role in SaaS or fintech

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, business, or a related field

  • Hands-on familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle Fusion) and finance/accounting workflows

  • Comfort with APIs, integration logic, and system architecture — and the ability to explain those concepts clearly to finance and operations stakeholders

  • Experience running product demonstrations and translating complex technical capabilities into clear business value

  • Strong communication skills: able to guide customers toward scalable approaches and diplomatically steer conversations when requests are misaligned with product capabilities or best practices

  • Collaborative mindset; effective working cross-functionally with Account Management, Product, and Engineering

  • Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments; highly organized, ownership-oriented, and resourceful as Ramp scales its upmarket motion

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location & Schedule: This position requires the ability to work remotely in Ukraine and regularly work shifts aligned with US business hours (Mon-Fri 4:00pm-3:00 am).

The Technical Onboarding Specialist / Onboarding Technician is responsible for guiding new customers through the setup, configuration, and successful adoption of Nextiva’s platform. This role combines customer support, technical configuration, and product training to ensure a seamless onboarding experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist customers with initial account setup via phone and screen share
  • Guide customers through login, configuration, and product functionality
  • Configure accounts, call flows, and devices with accuracy and attention to detail
  • Perform network checks and basic troubleshooting
  • Test configurations to ensure successful implementation
  • Deliver customer training on features and product usage
  • Meet daily productivity and performance metrics (appointments, call handling, completion rates)
  • Handle both inbound onboarding calls and scheduled appointments
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with teams such as Sales, Product Support, CRM, and other internal groups to improve the overall customer experience

AI & Future-Focused Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate interest in AI tools and automation in customer support/onboarding workflows
  • Collaborate with AI-driven onboarding systems by handling escalations or edge cases AI cannot resolve
  • Contribute insights to improve AI onboarding agents based on real customer scenarios
  • Adapt to a future-state environment where onboarding is increasingly AI-assisted and backend-focused

Qualifications

  • Proficient English (written and verbal communication)
  • Experience in a customer-facing or support role
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong communication and active listening skills
  • Commitment to delivering amazing customer service
  • Attention to detail and time management
  • Basic technical aptitude (software support, device setup, networking fundamentals)

Preferred

  • Experience with CRM tools
  • Microsoft Office proficiency
  • VoIP experience preferred
  • Basic networking knowledge
  • Exposure to or curiosity about AI tools, automation, or prompt-based systems

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

title: Product Engineer
description:
GovSignals is next-gen acquisition for the Department of War.

It can take the government longer to buy a capability than an adversary takes to field one, and we exist to close that gap.

We're the only startup managing government contract data with AI in both FedRAMP High and DoW Impact Level 5 environments. Our platform monitors 5,000+ live government data sources, 100,000+ federal and state agencies, and 2,000,000+ government contracts in real time. Our customers in government include offices like DIU and SOCOM, and our customers in industry range from small contractors to Fortune 500 primes with billions in annual awards.

Product Engineer

Remote - U.S. • Full-time

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Engineer to expand our product engineering team. You'll work directly with the CPO and own entire customer-facing product areas from whiteboard to production.

Our users run billions of dollars in government contracts through GovSignals. You'll plan, build and ship features daily, and you'll own them once they're live. When something you built breaks at 9pm you are the one who fixes it. The work arrives as a goal rather than a spec, and you decide what to build.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Take ownership of high-impact product areas and ship customer-facing improvements daily, from whiteboard to production.

  • Rapidly iterate on UI, UX, and core application logic based on real user feedback and production data.

  • Decompose ambiguous product goals into clear engineering plans, execute them, and measure outcomes.

  • Work with the deployment team and directly with customers to understand where the product falls short, then decide what to do about it.

Our stack: Kubernetes, AWS GovCloud, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, SvelteKit, TypeScript, Trigger.dev, Postgres, UDS.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of full-stack engineering with a proven record of shipping customer-facing features end-to-end.

  • Government or defense experience: building software for government users, working at a defense tech company, military service, or contracting work on either side of the table.

  • Strong frontend TypeScript skills with modern frameworks (Svelte/SvelteKit strongly preferred; React/Next.js acceptable).

  • Hands-on Postgres and backend TypeScript experience. You have designed schemas, written migrations, and optimized queries.

  • Ability to decompose ambiguous problems into shippable increments and communicate tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where priorities shift and you own the outcome.

Nice to have: AI-first UX patterns, RAG pipelines, or AI agent architectures; experience in FedRAMP, IL, HIPAA, or other regulated environments; open-source work.

Clearance: not required. An active or previous clearance is a plus.

THE TEAM

GovSignals was founded by four cofounders who lived with this problem from both sides (selling to the government and serving inside it) with backgrounds across the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Department of Energy, Palantir, Amazon, federal contractors building for missiles, and state contractors building for prisons. You'll work directly with all four. Other team members at GovSignals have shipped to defense companies, scaled venture-backed startups, and founded companies of their own.

HOW WE WORK

Design by HI (Human Intelligence), Work by AI (Artificial Intelligence). Human Intelligence takes responsibility for what we build and how we communicate to customers. Artificial Intelligence does much of the building. We provide unlimited Claude and ChatGPT credits for reasonable use, and we expect you to come in with extensive AI experience.

HOW WE HIRE

  • Intro conversation (30 min): your background and how you work.

  • Technical interview (1 hr): real-world inspired technical exercises.

  • Co-founder conversations (15 min): meet the cofounders.

  • Work trial (1 day): real work with the team.

  • Offer.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Base Salary: $160,000 – $230,000

  • Equity: Meaningful stake in a well-funded, fast-growing startup

  • Benefits: medical, vision, and dental, unlimited PTO

  • Brooklyn Navy Yard office, 3+ days a week in person. The Yard built ships for the Navy from 1801 to 1966, now we build systems for Navy program offices.

Due to the nature of our government work, this role is open only to U.S. citizens and other U.S. Persons. GovSignals is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Corporate Counsel, Commercial
description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each memberâs life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries â from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity ð

As Corporate Counsel, Commercial, you will be the legal partner behind Carrotâs customer and vendor contracts. Day to day, you will negotiate, draft, and review a high volume of commercial agreements, including master services agreements, service level agreements, professional services agreements, and NDAs. You will partner closely with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions quickly, manage most matters from start to finish, and escalate high-risk issues when the moment calls for it.

This role is built for an attorney who pairs sharp legal judgment with practical business thinking. You will help move deals toward close while managing risk thoughtfully, supporting employers, health plans, and health systems around the world. You will join a collaborative Legal team and have support as you grow into greater independence and take on work with limited oversight.

Â 

What Youâll Own ð¼

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions efficiently and keep deal timelines on track.

  • Identify and explain operational and revenue-related risks, and escalate high-risk issues at the right time.
  • Manage a high volume of contracts at all times while protecting quality and turnaround speed.
  • Support privacy and data protection terms in commercial agreements, including HIPAA Business Associate Agreements and Data Protection Agreements.
  • Work across a complex, global matrix of collaborators to support Carrotâs growth.
  • Use contract lifecycle management and AI tools to improve the efficiency of legal research, drafting, and contract workflows.

Â 

What Success Looks Like Â ð

In your first 12â18 months, you will have:

  • Independently managed a high volume of commercial contracts from intake to signature with consistently timely turnarounds.
  • Become a trusted legal partner to Sales and other client groups, resolving redlines and customer questions efficiently.

  • Escalated high-risk issues proactively, with clear recommendations for the business.
  • Built working fluency in Carrotâs products, customer segments, and the global fertility and family-building landscape, and applied it to practical negotiating positions.
  • Improved contract workflows by making full use of Ironclad and AI-enabled tools.




About You â¨

You likely have:

  • A J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 3+ years of legal experience, in-house and/or at a law firm, ideally with in-house transactional experience at a health plan or startup.
  • A strong grasp of contracting concepts and solid experience drafting, negotiating, and interpreting commercial and vendor agreements such as MSAs, SLAs, professional services agreements, and NDAs.
  • Experience counseling a sales organization.
  • The ability to analyze and advise on legal and regulatory risk, with creative solutions that support growth.
  • Flexibility, a willingness to work on a broad variety of legal matters, and comfort with ambiguity.
  • A record of strategic thinking and of working across a complex matrix of global collaborators, pairing strong legal analysis with practical business recommendations.

Â 

Nice to Have â­

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts with global companies.
  • Experience with complex multi-party commercial agreements and vendor agreement review.
  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle management software, especially Ironclad.
  • Experience using AI tools.
  • Knowledge of privacy laws including HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR in the context of BAAs and DPAs.
  • Interest in fertility and reproductive health policy, and how it differs by country and culture.
  • Knowledge of the employee benefits, healthcare, and/or pharmaceutical industries.

Â 

Why This Role Matters ð§¡

Carrotâs contracts are how our mission reaches people. Every agreement with an employer, health plan, or health system shapes how well members around the world can access fertility and family-building care. In this role, you help Carrot say yes to growth in ways that protect the company, our customers, and the members we serve.

Because you will own most matters from beginning to end, your judgment directly affects deal velocity, customer trust, and revenue. You will be a visible, trusted partner to Sales and the broader business while helping a rapidly growing global company scale its commercial legal function.



Interview Process ð¤

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview â 30â45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews â 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation â 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Â 

Why Candidates Join Carrot ð

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Â 

Â 

Compensationð°

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support you in all aspects of life, inside and outside of work. Our benefits include comprehensive health and wellness coverage, retirement savings plans, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. This role is:

Base + equity roles:
Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrot's long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.

  • Base Salary Range:Â  $140,000-$160,000
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: ForÂ highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.



Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

Â 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirementâand we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcareâs Innovators. Carrotâs global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortuneâs Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. description:
Our Mission

Healthie is an AI-Native, ONC Certified EHR for modern outpatient healthcare.Â 

Healthie is proud to power clinically excellent healthcare for over 40,000 providers who deliver clinically excellent healthcare - longitudinal and collaboratively, with patient and provider experiences at the center. Our fully brandable platform makes it easy for clinics and organizations of any size to scale and never reach a limit.Â 

Today, over 3 billion API calls are made to Healthie every month, as thousands of organizations who work with more than 21 million patients in total, rely on Healthie to deliver clinically excellent healthcare in over 35 specialties, from behavioral healthcare to complex chronic care management and personalized medicine.

We believe in the power of technology to improve access to healthcare and weâre building the rails that make this a reality. We work fast and with quality because we provide business-critical, healthcare-critical software that clinicians and patients need for a better healthcare system. Weâre customer-obsessed, operate with lightning-fast processes and responses, and always share our product roadmap publicly-Â  so customers can see what weâre building, and remain relentlessly focused on how care gets delivered.

Healthie is backed by leading investors, and while we've $42M raised to date, more importantly, we operate with fiscal responsibility and have been profitable for more than half of our time as a company. We know that building an ONC-Certified EHR is a lifetimeâs body of work, and we are here to build for our customers forever.

Learn more at https://www.gethealthie.com/

About the role

Weâre hiring a Customer Success Manager to join our Private Practice Enablement team and help customers get the most out of Healthie throughout their entire journey with us. Youâll work with private practices and growing healthcare organizationsâsome brand new to Healthie, others who have been with us for years.

This is a highly customer-facing role centered around understanding how practices operate and helping them use Healthie to accomplish their goals. Youâll build relationships with healthcare executives, practice managers, providers, and clinical champions, becoming a trusted resource as their workflows, teams, and needs evolve.

Our ideal hire is curious, resourceful, and a natural educator. You enjoy learning how different healthcare organizations work, can turn complex questions into clear next steps, and are excited to develop the product expertise needed to help customers use Healthie successfully.

About the work

  • Youâll spend much of your day connecting directly with customers through live 1:1 calls and email, helping with everything from initial setup and training to workflow optimization, feature adoption, and new needs that emerge as their practices grow.
  • Youâll learn how customers deliver care, understand their operational and patient care goals, and use deep product knowledge to recommend workflows that make Healthie work for their organization.
  • Youâll solve problems in real time. Sometimes thereâs a straightforward answer; other times youâll need to investigate, think creatively, test different approaches, or bring in the right people to find a solution.

  • Youâll manage multiple customer conversations and priorities at once, adapting your communication and approach to different practices, personalities, and challenges.
  • Youâll collaborate with Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, sharing what youâre learning from customers and helping improve our product, resources, processes, and overall customer experience.


Details, details

  • This is a full-time, remote position and U.S. work authorization is required.
  • This job is Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm PST.Â 
  • Weâre seeking fluent English speakers/writers.
  • The salary range is $93,000 - $102,500

About you

Youâve done this kind of work before. Weâre looking for someone with 3â5 years of experience in Customer Success or similar customer-facing role. And it is a requirement that you've worked at a software company. Bonus points if youâve worked in healthcare technology, or have experience working with private practices or growing healthcare organizations.

  • Youâre comfortable independently leading customer conversations and building relationships with everyone from individual providers to practice managers and healthcare leaders. You ask thoughtful questions, listen closely, and know how to adapt your approach to the person in front of you.
  • Youâre a natural educator and an excellent communicator. You can take complicated products, workflows, and questions and turn them into clear, practical next steps. We value good writers.
  • Youâre curious about how customers work. You want to understand what someone is actually trying to accomplish before recommending a solution, and you enjoy learning the different ways healthcare organizations operate and deliver care.
  • Youâre a strong problem-solver with good judgment. When there isnât an obvious answer, youâre comfortable researching, testing different approaches, and using the resources around you to figure out the best path forward.
  • Youâre organized and self-directed. You can manage customer calls, emails, follow-ups, and projects simultaneously, take ownership of whatâs in front of you, and recognize when something needs another perspective or team.
  • Youâre good at navigating challenging conversations. You can set expectations, explain limitations, and provide thoughtful guidance even when the answer isnât exactly what a customer hoped to hear.
  • You have plenty of tech skills, and you're confident working across a variety of tools and apps, and can troubleshoot everyday issues on your ownâthings like browser quirks, connectivity problems, login hiccups, and mobile device settings.
  • Youâre a collaborative teammate and strong customer advocate. You share what youâre learning, give helpful and direct feedback, and bring patterns from customer conversations back to the broader team so we can continue improving how we support our customers and build Healthie.

How to applyÂ 

Please submit a PDF cover letter and introduce yourself. Include:

  • Tell us who you are and why you want this job at Healthie.
  • Where are you based and what time zone are you in?
  • Why do you want to work in Customer Success?

In your cover letter, answer these real-world customer scenarios. Reply to the customer directly like you would if you worked on our Private Practice team. Also tell us how youâd approach the conversation, and explain your thinking for each reply.Â 

  • A customer recently signed up for Healthie and is excited to get started. They want to go live as soon as possible and have an upcoming appointment with a client. They need help manually adding the client to Healthie and sending them an invitation to access the platform.

  • A customer who has been using Healthie for several years reaches out because their practice has grown and their current workflow is no longer working well for their team. They have a specific idea for how theyâd like to solve the problem, but you arenât sure whether Healthie can support exactly what theyâre asking for.Â 

Interview Process

  • Quick chat with our Talent team (15 minutes)
  • Interview with Talita, Private Practice Team Lead (30 minutes)
  • Interview with Justin, VP of Customer Support (30 minutes)
  • Live demo with Talita and Jen (30 minutes)
    • Youâll be asked to give us a brief product demo. Youâll share your screen and show us how to add a client and schedule an appointment.Â 
  • Final session with Talita and Justin (30 minutes)
  • Reference checks

Healthie is subject to HIPAA and other security and privacy frameworks, and this job entails training and conformance to expectations regarding security and compliance.

Healthie participates in e-verify.

Healthie is committed to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category. description:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.Â

  • Proven experience with employee expense policy verification and processing.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

Preferred Experience

Â 

Â 

Life at Ping:

Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because thatâs who we want to succeed with every day.Â

title: Compliance Officer/MLRO
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Â 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Â 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Purpose

Lead the establishment and ongoing oversight of the Pakistan entityâs independent Compliance function and Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Counter-Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) framework.
During the pre-licensing phase, the role holder will lead Compliance-owned licensing deliverables, develop the local control framework and assess operational readiness. Following licensing, the role holder will discharge the entityâs CO/MLRO responsibilities, advise the Board and senior management, and maintain effective engagement with PVARA, the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) and other relevant authorities.
The role combines CO and MLRO responsibilities, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and any required regulatory acceptance or approval. The suitability of the combined arrangement will be reviewed periodically, considering independence, conflicts, capacity, resources and the entityâs nature, scale and complexity.
Â 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Licensing and Operational Readiness
  • Lead Compliance-owned components of the PVARA licensing application and coordinate relevant inputs from Legal, Business, Risk, Finance, Operations and Technology.
  • Develop and maintain a regulatory obligations register, licensing deliverables tracker and local implementation roadmap.
  • Assess gaps between group policies, systems and controls and applicable Pakistan requirements; oversee localisation and track remediation.
  • Establish local Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF policies, governance arrangements, escalation procedures and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Define local control requirements for customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, Travel Rule compliance and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Assess the suitability and readiness of local, group-provided and outsourced controls, including relevant pre-launch testing.
  • Provide a documented Compliance and AML readiness assessment to the appropriate governance forum, escalating unresolved material gaps before launch.
Â 
  1. Compliance Oversight
  • Establish, administer and maintain a documented, risk-based Compliance Management System (CMS) proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • Advise the Board, relevant committees and senior management on applicable legal and regulatory requirements, licence conditions and regulatory developments.
  • Develop and execute a risk-based Compliance Monitoring and Testing Plan; document findings, agree remediation ownership and deadlines with accountable functions, independently validate closure, and escalate overdue or inadequate remediation.
  • Oversee compliance with applicable conduct, customer protection, complaints-handling, client-asset and market-integrity requirements, according to the entityâs licensed activities.
  • Review proposed products, services and material business changes from a local compliance perspective, identifying requirements, restrictions and necessary controls.
  • Ensure material non-compliance is investigated, promptly escalated and remediated, and notified to PVARA where required.
  • Maintain regulatory submission and commitment trackers, overseeing timely and accurate Compliance-owned responses and escalating dependency risks.
  • Act as the primary Compliance liaison with PVARA for supervisory engagement, inspections and information requests.
  • Develop and oversee Compliance training for employees, senior management and relevant key individuals.
Â 
  1. AML/CFT/CPF and Financial Crime
  • Establish, implement and maintain the entityâs AML/CFT/CPF framework, aligned with applicable Pakistan legislation, regulatory requirements and relevant directions or guidance.
  • Lead the enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment and oversee risk-based mitigation measures.
  • Oversee customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, customer risk assessment, enhanced due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
  • Oversee transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and targeted financial sanctions controls, including escalation and action on relevant alerts.
  • Oversee virtual asset-specific controls, including blockchain analytics, risks associated with unhosted wallets and Travel Rule compliance where applicable.
  • Receive and assess internal suspicious activity referrals, determine whether external reporting is required, and submit suspicious transaction reports to the FMU within applicable deadlines.
  • Exercise independent judgement on suspicious transaction reporting without requiring business approval, while maintaining confidentiality and preventing tipping-off.
  • Manage the entityâs FMU/goAML registration, access arrangements and reporting processes, as applicable.
  • Ensure required customer, transaction and investigation records are retained for applicable periods and remain accessible and retrievable.
  • Liaise with the FMU and other competent authorities on financial crime matters and oversee relevant information requests.
  • Oversee AML/CFT/CPF training and awareness, tailored to employeesâ responsibilities and exposure to risk.
Â 
  1. Governance, Reporting and Control Assurance
  • Provide periodic reports to the Board or designated committee on Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF effectiveness, material risks, incidents, findings and remediation progress.
  • Escalate urgent or material matters promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.
  • Attend relevant Board and committee meetings and provide independent advice and challenge.
  • Assess and oversee group-provided and outsourced Compliance/AML services, including local regulatory suitability, service standards, data access, management information and escalation arrangements.
  • Oversee delegated Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF activities and remain accountable for discharging the CO/MLRO responsibilities, without displacing the responsibilities of the entity, Board, senior management or operational control owners.
  • Coordinate with Risk and Internal Audit, while preserving the distinction between Compliance oversight and independent audit assurance.
  • Support periodic review of the role holderâs continuing fitness, propriety and suitability, including the required review of the MLRO appointment.
  • Maintain effective handover and suitably qualified cover arrangements for absences, consistent with applicable regulatory requirements.
Â 

Qualifications and Experience

Essential
  • A degree in law, finance, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
  • At least eight yearsâ relevant Compliance and/or AML/CFT experience in financial services, including at least three years in a senior Compliance, MLRO or equivalent leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of Pakistanâs financial regulatory and AML/CFT framework, including the Virtual Assets Act, applicable PVARA regulations, the Anti-Money Laundering Act and FMU reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrable understanding of virtual asset business models and their financial crime, conduct and operational risks.
  • Practical experience with customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Experience developing risk assessments, policies, monitoring programmes and Board-level reporting.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into workable business, operational and technology controls.
  • Be resident in Pakistan by the date of the formal CO/MLRO appointment and maintain residency as required under applicable regulations.
  • Fluency in English and Urdu.
Â 
Desirable
  • Professional certification such as CAMS, an ICA qualification or an equivalent Compliance/AML credential.
  • Experience in virtual assets, exchanges, fintech or digital financial services.
  • Experience supporting a regulatory licence application or establishing a local Compliance function.
  • Experience engaging with PVARA, FMU, SECP, SBP or other relevant Pakistani authorities.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools and Travel Rule solutions.
  • Experience overseeing centralised group services and outsourced control arrangements.
Â 
Key Competencies
  • Independence, integrity and sound judgement.
  • Confidence to challenge senior management constructively.
  • Clear communication with regulators, the Board and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective prioritisation in a developing regulatory environment.
  • Ability to build a local control framework while working within a global organisation.
Â 
Authority and Independence
  • Direct access to the local Board or designated committee, including the ability to escalate without prior management clearance.
  • Timely and unrestricted access to relevant records, systems, personnel and management information necessary to discharge the role, subject to applicable confidentiality and data-handling requirements.
  • Adequate resources and suitably qualified support proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • No client-facing, sales or other responsibilities that compromise independence, create material conflicts or impair CO/MLRO duties.
  • Remuneration arrangements that do not link the role holderâs performance to sales or revenue targets.
  • Group reporting arrangements that do not restrict local regulatory accountability, Board access or independent MLRO decision-making.
  • Board oversight of appointment, replacement and removal, with regulatory approvals or notifications completed as applicable.
Â 
Regulatory Appointment Conditions
The role holder must satisfy applicable fitness and propriety, residency, employment, competence and regulatory appointment requirements at appointment and on an ongoing basis. Any required PVARA approval, acceptance or notification must be completed in accordance with the applicable framework.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.Â 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Product Operations Specialist (w/m/d)
description:
💡 We're looking for a Product Operations Specialist to join our Product Operations team - the team that makes sure the regulatory intelligence our customers depend on is complete, current and correct.

Medical device manufacturers use Flinn to stay on top of every standard, guidance and regulation they're legally required to follow. When an auditor asks them to prove they caught a change, our data is the evidence. Product Operations is what stands behind that promise: we curate and verify the regulatory data at the core of the product, set up and quality-assure every new customer account, and turn what we learn into better automation.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving environment. You'll work across Customer Success, Product and Engineering, and you'll have real influence on the roadmap - the improvements our team surfaces are a major driver of what gets built. It's a strong fit if you're precise by nature, energised by making messy processes work properly, and genuinely interested in using AI and automation to replace manual effort rather than accept it.

Why Flinn?

  • We are building a truly exceptional culture: While many companies claim to have a great culture, we invite you to discover what truly sets ours apart. Visit our career page, speak with our team, listen to our founders’ podcast, or experience our culture first-hand during the interview process.

  • Make a Meaningful Impact: Your work at Flinn contributes directly to solutions that improve people’s health and lives by making high-quality health products accessible for everyone.

  • Experienced, well-funded, highly professional: As well-funded startup veterans, we know how to sustain long-term business health and success, ensuring an environment for continuous personal growth.

What’s in it for you?

  • Join a fast-growing, well-funded European startup backed by experienced founders and investors.

  • Be part of a mission-driven health-tech company whose work directly improves people’s lives.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of core operational processes that keep the company running.

  • Play a key role in scaling Flinn, shaping how operations work as we grow.

  • Work in a high-trust, low-ego environment with autonomy and clear ownership.

  • Enjoy flexible working hours, remote flexibility, and regular team time in Vienna.

  • Work in a net-zero company where all unavoidable CO₂ emissions are compensated with carefully selected, high-quality removal certificates.

  • Receive one of the most employee-friendly equity packages, including fair vesting terms and profit-sharing opportunities.

  • Grow in a professional, high-standard environment that supports long-term personal and career development.

Your Contributions to Our Journey:

  • Take ownership of the quality and completeness of the regulatory data at the heart of our product - the foundation our customers' compliance and audit readiness rests on

  • Own the recurring monitoring and verification cycles that keep our regulatory coverage current, and be accountable for getting them done accurately and on time

  • Set up and maintain customer configurations end to end, and run the final quality gate before a customer goes live

  • Act as the connective tissue between Customer Success, Product and Engineering - surfacing issues early, translating operational reality into clear requirements, and escalating with evidence

  • Identify what's slow, manual or error-prone in how we work, and drive it toward automation together with Product and Engineering

  • Document and improve the processes and knowledge base the team runs on, so quality doesn't depend on who happens to be doing the work

What You Need to Be Successful:

Must-Have

  • 2+ years in operations, data operations, quality, project coordination, regulatory affairs or a comparable role. You're at home working through large volumes of structured information, cross-checking records against their original sources until they're right

  • Exceptional attention to detail combined with real pace. You work precisely without getting lost in the detail

  • Proactive communication with internal stakeholders - you keep Product, Engineering and Customer Success in the loop and flag blockers early instead of absorbing them

  • Strong prioritisation and organisational skills, and an agile mindset: priorities here shift, and you re-plan calmly and communicate clearly when they do

  • A drive to improve and automate - you've made a process better rather than just followed one, and you're genuinely interested in using AI and automation to eliminate manual work

Strong Plus

  • Interest in or familiarity with regulatory data and standards - in MedTech, pharma or another regulated industry, or through a life-science, regulatory affairs or quality management background

🇪🇺 At this stage of our company, we can only accept applications from people who are based in Europe with either European citizenship, an active working visa or being self-employed and joining us as a full-time contractor (Except for US-based roles).

We strive to remove barriers, eliminate discrimination, and ensure equal opportunity through our transparent recruitment process. We are open to all groups of people without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst Active Sourcing und Direktansprache über LinkedIn, XING und weitere passende Kanäle – mit dem Ziel, spannende SAP- und IT-Talente für GAMBIT zu gewinnen.
  • Du führst erste Gespräche, qualifizierst Kandidat:innen und begleitest den weiteren Bewerbungsprozess gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen.
  • Du baust Talent-Pipelines auf, pflegst Beziehungen zu relevanten Kontakten und sorgst für eine professionelle Candidate Experience.
  • Du koordinierst Personalberatungs-Partner, stimmst laufende Suchaufträge ab und behältst das Bewerbermanagement zuverlässig im Blick.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Recruiting-Aktivitäten weiter – von KI-gestützten Ansätzen über Recruiting-Marketing bis zur Sichtbarkeit unserer Arbeitgebermarke auf LinkedIn, XING, Kununu und in Hochschulnetzwerken.


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst Begeisterung für Active Sourcing mit und hast Freude daran, SAP Talente gezielt zu identifizieren, individuell anzusprechen und für GAMBIT zu gewinnen.
  • Du hast Recruiting und Bewerbermanagement ganzheitlich im Blick und begleitest Kandidat:innen zuverlässig durch die verschiedenen Prozessschritte.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und übernimmst auch administrative, organisatorische und planerische Aufgaben im Recruiting – von der Prozesssteuerung bis zur Abstimmung mit Fachbereichen und externen Partnern.
  • Du interessierst dich für Employer Branding und Recruiting-Marketing und möchtest dazu beitragen, GAMBIT im Talentmarkt noch sichtbarer und attraktiver zu machen.
  • Du hast Lust, KI und neue Ansätze im Recruiting auszuprobieren und unsere Sourcing-Strategien dadurch aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.

Persönlich 

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und wertschätzend mit Kandidat:innen, Fachbereichen und externen Partnern.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und behältst auch mehrere Suchaufträge und Prozessschritte zuverlässig im Blick.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Beziehungen aufzubauen, Talente zu begeistern und langfristig mit passenden Menschen in Kontakt zu bleiben.
  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative, Neugier und Lust auf Gestaltung mit – besonders, wenn es darum geht, neue Recruiting-Ansätze auszuprobieren.
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, denkst mit und gehst professionell mit sensiblen Informationen im Bewerbungsprozess um.


Warum wir?

  • Wir sind ein unabhängiges, inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit 30 Jahren Wachstumsgeschichte und klarem Fokus auf moderne Technologien und smarte Lösungen – das macht deinen Arbeitsplatz langfristig sicher.
  • Kernarbeitszeiten gibt es bei uns nicht. Du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeit eigenverantwortlich und stimmst sie mit Kunden- und Team-Terminen ab.
  • Der Austausch mit den Führungskräften und der Geschäftsführung ist direkt, unkompliziert und wertschätzend. Auch die Unterstützung durch deine Kolleg:innen und das Management erhältst du schnell und ohne Umwege.
  • Eine Anwesenheitspflicht im Büro gibt es nicht. Du bist an unserem Headquarter in Troisdorf jederzeit herzlich willkommen, entscheidest aber selbst oder im Team, wann du vor Ort arbeitest.
  • Ständig unterwegs? Nicht bei uns. Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und reisen nur anlassbezogen.
  • Getränke wie Wasser, Säfte, Tee und Kaffee sind bei uns selbstverständlich kostenfrei.
  • Zusätzlich versorgen wir dich am Standort in Troisdorf mit leckeren Brötchen am Morgen und einem frisch gekochten Mittagsmenü in Bio-Qualität – beides ebenfalls kostenfrei.
  • Wir bieten dir ein attraktives und faires Gehalt auf der Basis aktueller interner und externer Benchmarks.
  • Volle Flexibilität für deinen Alltag: Firmenwagen mit E-Antrieb inklusive Ladestation am Standort und auf Wunsch zusätzlich ein JobRad, mit dem du dich fit halten kannst.

description:
This role is for one of our clients

Compensation: $70 - $100 per hour

Location: Remote – United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, Spain, or Switzerland
Employment Type: Full-Time
Workload: Approximately 40 hours per week
Compensation: Based on location and professional experience

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced FP&A Specialist to work with a leading AI company as part of its internal finance team. This role focuses on core corporate finance activities, including financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, performance reporting, and business partnering.

You will operate as an in-house finance professional, working closely with business leaders and functional teams to provide financial insights, support strategic decisions, and strengthen financial planning processes as the organisation continues to scale.

This is a full-time, remote opportunity for finance professionals based in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, Spain, or Switzerland.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, manage, and maintain annual budgets, financial forecasts, and multi-year financial plans.
  • Conduct monthly and quarterly variance analysis, identifying key financial trends and explaining performance drivers to business stakeholders.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support headcount planning, operational spending, resource allocation, and investment decisions.
  • Build, maintain, and enhance financial models, dashboards, and management reporting frameworks.
  • Support month-end closing activities and prepare financial reports for senior leadership.
  • Translate financial data into actionable insights to support business planning and strategic decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial planning processes, reporting accuracy, and finance tools as the organisation grows.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 7+ years of experience in corporate finance, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), or finance business partnering, primarily in an in-house environment.
  • Previous experience working in technology companies, high-growth businesses, or similarly dynamic organisations is preferred.
  • Proven ability to independently manage financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting responsibilities.
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders and collaborating with non-finance teams to drive business decisions.
  • Strong financial modelling capabilities and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate financial insights.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with financial planning and analysis platforms such as Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, or Pigment.
  • Professional accounting or finance qualifications such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or CFA.
  • Experience improving financial reporting systems, planning processes, and management dashboards.

Important Candidate Criteria

  • Senior individual contributors are encouraged to apply; a people-management title is not mandatory.
  • Candidates should have substantial hands-on, in-house FP&A or corporate finance experience.
  • Investment banking or private equity experience alone will not be considered sufficient for this role.
  • English is the required working and interview language.

Application Process

  1. Submit your updated resume.
  2. Complete a short screening form.
  3. Participate in a short AI interview, selecting FP&A or Finance Business Partnering as your domain.

Engagement & Compensation

The engagement structure, whether an independent contractor arrangement or employment through a local partner, will be confirmed during the hiring process. Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's location, experience, and professional expertise and discussed during the screening stage.

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will be considered based on their relevant skills, experience, and professional qualifications, without unlawful discrimination under applicable local laws. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application process upon request.
