title: Core Account Executive - DACH
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Are you a high-achieving sales professional ready to digitally transform the physical operations that power our planet? Samsara is seeking a driven Enterprise (Core) Account Executive to introduce our cutting-edge Connected Operations® Platform to Enterprise-sized customers across the DACH region. This is a unique opportunity to sell a much-needed product into a historically underserved market, working directly with leaders to drive real-world impact and unlock significant career progression. As a Strategic AE you will be helping large mid-market and enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

Whilst the individual can work remotely anywhere in Germany, the role will entail travel to customer sites across the region as required


In this role, you will: 

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices


Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in Enterprise level accounts, winning multiple $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Proven expertise winning new business logos through a repeatable sales motion
  • Demonstrable expertise in strategic outbound prospecting, particularly via inside sales
  • Experience handling enterprise deal sizes with multiple stakeholders at C-Level
  • Value based selling approach, leveraging Command of the Message, MEDDPICC or similar
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Native-level German language skills


An ideal candidate also has:

  • SaaS sales experience
  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience or similar (Sandler Pain Funnel, etc)
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset. 
  • Awards for top achievement (President's club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Equity Partner/ Partner Unternehmensberatung / Business Mentor / Geschäftsführer
description:
Machen Sie den nächsten Schritt und arbeiten Sie mit einem vertrauenswürdigen Business Consulting - Executive Mentoring-Netzwerk zusammen.

Sind Sie erfolgreich im Führen von Geschäftseinheiten, mit unternehmerischer Denkweise und einer Leidenschaft dafür, kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen zu unterstützen? Möchten Sie Ihre Führungserfahrung als Partner eines vertrauenswürdigen Unternehmensberatungs- und Executive Mentoring-Unternehmens nutzen, das KMU in einer der dynamischsten Regionen Deutschlands vorantreibt?

thexton armstrong lädt leitende Führungskräfte und erfahrene Unternehmer ein sich als Geschäftsführer / selbstständiger Partner bei thexton armstrong zu bewerben.

Über uns

thexton armstrong ist ein internationales Beratungsnetzwerk, das sich auf Unternehmens-Mentoring und Wachstumsberatung für KMU spezialisiert hat. Seit 2012 haben wir Tausenden von Geschäftsinhabern geholfen, Rentabilität, Resilienz und langfristigen Wertzuwachs durch ein strukturiertes Business-Mentoring-Framework zu stärken, das praktische Erfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen verbindet.

Da wir selbst Unternehmer sind, agieren wir als Franchise, bei dem jeder Partner seine eigene Firma oder Praxis mit begrenzten Anfangskapitalanforderungen führt und ausbaut. Obwohl unabhängig, kann jeder Partner das gesamte Fachwissen und die Dienstleistungen des Partnernetzwerk-Supports nutzen und gleichzeitig sein eigenes Risiko als Partner minimieren.

Wir sind derzeit erfolgreich in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Süddeutschland, der Schweiz und dem Vereinigten Königreich tätig und expandieren nun in Nord- und Ostdeutschland sowie bald auch in Westdeutschland.

Aufgaben

Ihre Chance

Dies ist eine seltene Gelegenheit als Partner Ihr eigenes Beratungsunternehmen in einem Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Kollegen aufzubauen und zu führen, während Sie Teil eines etablierten und bewährten Systems sind.

title: Tritium Process Engineers
company: Personal data collected as part of the application process
description:
About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC)

GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle.  Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s.

While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB).

A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs). 

A conceptual design is currently under development, with the project then progressing into pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED) in 2028, followed by front-end engineering design (FEED) and design for manufacturing phases. Completion of the overall design phase (for GID-170) must be achieved by 2032.


About the role

GFG is looking for several Tritium Process Engineers to join the TFC department and develop the GID-170 and GIGA TFC facilities. The roles will contribute to the continued development and optimisation of the overall fuel cycle architecture and its subsystems. Activities will include managing design requirements; developing process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), heat and mass balances (HMBs) and the Basis of Design (BoD); selecting technologies; sizing and arranging equipment; and contributing to safety-related design. The roles may also involve supporting equipment prototype development and testing with technology developers and research partners.
We welcome candidates with complementary strengths in process design and process modelling and simulation, with systems engineering experience also desirable. These specialisations sit within the same engineering function, and candidates are not expected to have equal expertise across all areas. The number of appointments and balance of responsibilities will reflect the successful candidates’ experience and technical strengths. Drawing on their specialist expertise, successful candidates will work collaboratively on design development, modelling, analysis and optimisation to assess design alternatives and inform robust, well-documented design decisions.
The TFC comprises a wide range of technologies and subsystems, requiring the department to manage multiple sub-projects and work packages in parallel. Each engineer will contribute across several activities and will be expected to take ownership of specific tasks or subsystems, or lead work packages, depending on their experience. The roles will involve close collaboration with engineers from the same and other disciplines at national and international partner organisations, research institutions and suppliers, as well as with colleagues across disciplines and departments within GFG. Given the specific challenges associated with tritium, close collaboration with Nuclear Safety and Export Control specialists will also be essential.
During conceptual design, successful candidates will work closely with the Head of Tritium Fuel Cycle to address the strong interdependencies between subsystems and develop a coherent, integrated design. As the project moves into pre-FEED, they will be expected to take greater day-to-day ownership of their assigned areas and drive design development through pre-FEED and FEED, while maintaining close coordination across subsystem interfaces. As the project progresses, the roles will evolve to support design for manufacture, procurement and commissioning of the GID-170 TFC systems, followed by further development and refinement of the TFC design for GIGA.


Main responsibilities

  • Process definition and systems engineering
    1. Identify, define and manage system requirements and interfaces across TFC subsystems and the overall plant architecture.
    2. Develop and optimise the fuel cycle architecture, assessing alternative subsystem technologies, their respective advantages and disadvantages, technology readiness levels (TRLs), and potential system configurations.
    3. Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs) for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture.
    4. Participate in the development of piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), identification and sizing of key components, and equipment layout.
    5. Develop and maintain representative heat and mass balances to support process definition, system integration and design decisions.
  • Process modelling and simulation
    1. Develop, apply and improve process simulation models for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture, using tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen Custom Modeler, Python and dedicated proprietary software, as appropriate.
    2. Support the development and integration of custom models and, where appropriate, contribute to the development of dedicated simulation tools.
    3. Use modelling and simulation to assess system performance, compare technology options and operating configurations, support component sizing, and inform process optimisation and design decisions.
    4. Documentation of assumptions, uncertainty and applicability limits, and perform model validation when suitable data becomes available.
    5. Work collaboratively with internal and external modelling specialists to ensure consistency between simulation results, engineering requirements and the evolving plant design.
  • Cost, safety and risk management
    1. Identify and manage design risks, developing effective risk-reduction strategies and action plans.
    2. Identify applicable standards, regulations and codes, and ensure that these are considered throughout the design process. 
    3. Participate in hazard, safety and accident analyses, including hazard identification (HAZID) and hazard and operability (HAZOP) studies, and contribute to the definition of safety functions and development of the safety case.
    4. Contribute to capital and operational expenditure (CAPEX/OPEX) estimates.
  • Design development and delivery
    1. Develop design documentation and specifications, including contributions to the Basis of Design and design philosophies.
    2. Document design studies, verification and assessment activities, engineering assumptions and design decisions.
    3. Support the design development, procurement and testing of prototypes for key components, in collaboration with technology developers, suppliers and research partners.
    4. Provide engineering support for R&D activities conducted in-house and with external partners and collaborators.
  • Project coordination and collaboration
    1. Lead specific technical tasks or work packages assigned by the Head of TFC, in line with experience and expertise.
    2. Take ownership of specific subsystems throughout the pre-FEED and FEED studies, as assigned by the Head of TFC, in line with experience and expertise.
    3. Participate in technical meetings with partners, suppliers, research institutions and other collaborators.
    4. Collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines and contribute to the integration of TFC systems within the wider fusion plant.
    5. As required, undertake other relevant duties in support of project objectives.
  • GID-170 delivery (in the 2030s)
    1. Support the procurement and installation activities of the GID-170 TFC facilities.
    2. Develop commissioning plans and operating instructions.
The balance between process design, systems engineering, and process modelling and simulation will depend on each candidate’s background and area of expertise. All engineers are expected to work collaboratively across these areas, ensuring that modelling activities inform engineering decisions and that process design is supported by robust analysis.


Qualification and educational requirements

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in chemical engineering, process engineering, nuclear engineering, or a closely related discipline*. 

*In the case of a closely related discipline, the degree should be supported by relevant chemical engineering experience.

  • A minimum of 3 years design experience working as a Process Engineer in an industrial environment.

    Additional desirable qualifications relevant to process modelling and simulation:
  • A PhD or EngD in Chemical or Process Engineering or a closely related field.


Competences and preferred skills

1. Common skills

Essential

All applicants should demonstrate:

  • In-depth knowledge of chemical engineering principles, including thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics, and relevant transport phenomena.
  • Experience in the development of industrial-scale process engineering installations in complex environments requiring regulatory approval (ideally nuclear projects or similar).
  • Experience in the development of processes involving different fluids and conditions (cryogenic, vacuum, atmospheric pressure gas, high-pressure gas (up to 100 bara), liquid, etc.).
  • Experience in the design and development of integrated treatment unit operations (purification, separation, conditioning, etc.), ideally in the gas phase, and in the hydrogen or nuclear sectors.
  • Proficiency in at least one established process simulation tool, such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, UniSim, gPROMS, ProMax, CHEMCAD or equivalent.
  • Experience in requirements capture, documentation and management.
  • Experience working alongside multiple other engineering disciplines, such as mechanical, electrical, control, thermal and nuclear engineers.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams of engineers, technologists and physicists.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.
  • Professional working proficiency in English. 

Desirable

All applicants would benefit from demonstrating:

  • Knowledge of tritium fuel cycle technologies and/or hydrogen isotope separation. Hands-on experience working with tritium would be an advantage.
  • Experience with the design or analysis of pumping technologies, heat exchangers or other key process equipment.
  • Familiarity with magnetic fusion systems and/or nuclear power plant systems.
  • Familiarity with environmental, nuclear safety and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
  • Knowledge of systems engineering and an understanding of configuration management and risk management.
  • Understanding of equipment qualification, manufacture, testing, inspection and pragmatic usability.
  • Knowledge of German or other European languages.

2. Specialist Skills

Candidates are expected to demonstrate strengths in one or more of the following areas, depending on their background and specialisation.

Process design and systems engineering

  • Experience in developing process architectures, heat and mass balances, PFDs and P&IDs, and in supporting equipment selection, sizing and integration.
  • Experience in developing Basis of Design (BoD) documentation, design philosophies, specifications, design descriptions and justifications.
  • Ability to assess alternative process technologies and configurations, considering performance, safety, technical maturity and operational requirements.
  • Experience in translating system requirements and process analysis into engineering specifications and design decisions.
  • Familiarity with process safety codes, standards and regulations, as well as safety-by-design principles, including the ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable) approach.
  • Experience in engaging with potential technology suppliers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

Process modelling and simulation

  • Proficiency in process modelling tools such as Aspen Custom Modeler, gPROMS custom modelling or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scientific computing language, such as Python, Julia, MATLAB, Octave or C++.
  • Strong understanding of numerical methods applied to chemical engineering, including ordinary and partial differential equations (ODEs and PDEs), differential-algebraic equations (DAEs), discretisation techniques and numerical convergence.
  • Knowledge of numerical optimisation methods and their implementation, with the ability to apply them to process analysis and design optimisation.
  • Experience developing custom process models, integrating subsystem models or analysing dynamic process behaviour, along with model automation and analysis, to assess system performance, compare design options and support process optimisation is an advantage.


We are recruiting engineers with complementary technical strengths. Applicants who meet the common essential criteria and have relevant capability in one specialist profile are encouraged to apply; experience in every technology or software package listed is not expected.


The balance of responsibilities and the level of technical ownership will be agreed according to each successful candidate’s experience and the needs of the programme, with opportunities for candidates to grow and develop into greater technical ownership.

title: Core Account Executive - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

  • Proven expertise winning new business logos through a repeatable sales motion

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience or similar (Sandler Pain Funnel, etc)
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset. 
  • Awards for top achievement (President's club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

title: AI Software Architect
description:
We are currently looking for an experienced AI Software Architect to join our client, a world-leading high-end CAE software company, and contribute to the development of its next-generation application platform.

You will play a key role in shaping the architecture, engineering standards and development practices required to build and operate scalable AI-powered applications.

In this position, you will work closely with product and platform engineering teams, helping them turn machine learning models into maintainable production applications. Combining strong software engineering expertise with a pragmatic architectural mindset, you will establish reusable solutions, improve integration with the AI platform and support teams in making sound technical decisions.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Define and establish practical application architecture patterns and interfaces for integrating machine learning models, data processing and inference capabilities into product applications.

  • Support product and platform teams in developing scalable, maintainable and production-ready AI-powered applications.

  • Drive cross-team architectural decisions through focused architecture reviews, technical prototypes and hands-on engineering guidance.

  • Identify opportunities to develop and share reusable software components, whether based on existing open-source solutions or internally developed technologies.

  • Promote consistent engineering practices, ensuring shared components have clear ownership, automated testing and well-defined, compatible interfaces.

  • Work closely with product and platform engineers to translate concrete application requirements into prioritised platform capabilities and technical improvements.

  • Evaluate existing solutions and identify opportunities to build on established components rather than introducing unnecessary complexity.

  • Support knowledge sharing and collaboration across engineering teams, helping establish common standards and proven approaches for AI application development.

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the application platform and its architecture as machine learning becomes more deeply integrated into AutoForm’s products.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Natural Sciences or a comparable discipline; equivalent practical experience is also considered.

  • Several years of professional experience in software engineering, including responsibility for the architecture and design of production software.

  • Practical experience integrating machine learning models into production applications.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, application design and the development of maintainable, scalable software solutions.

  • Experience defining reusable application patterns, interfaces and engineering standards across multiple teams.

  • Pragmatic approach to software design, with a focus on maintainability, simplicity and meaningful reuse.

  • Ability to assess technical solutions, identify opportunities for improvement and make architecture decisions that balance long-term quality with practical delivery needs.

title: Commercial Account Executive, META
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Role Description

Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s META growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular travel to the region, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our META Commercial team.

We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week.

What You’ll Do

Grow Horizon3.ai’s META Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions.

  • Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the META market.

  • Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter.

  • Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities.

  • Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.

  • Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention.

  • Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood.

  • Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 3-5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas.

  • Previous experience selling technical solutions into the META region.

  • Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential.

  • Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management.

  • The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person.

  • Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC).

  • Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack.

  • The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams.

  • Fluency in English and Arabic; additional language skills such as French are welcomed.

Travel Required

We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

title: Internal Communications Internship
description:
About the role

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

As our Internal Communications Intern, you’ll join our Marketing & Communications team and help keep colleagues across SkyNRG informed, connected and engaged. Working closely with our PR & Communications Manager and teams across the business, you’ll create engaging content, support internal campaigns and events, and help improve the channels and tools we use to communicate.

Your Responsibilities

  • Content creation: Draft and publish newsletters, intranet articles, announcements, interviews, employee stories and leadership updates.

  • Employee engagement: Support internal campaigns, company events and town halls that connect and engage colleagues across SkyNRG.

  • Channels & tools: Maintain internal communication channels and content calendars and help improve the processes and tools behind them.

  • Collaboration: Work with teams across the organization to gather information and turn it into clear and engaging communication.

  • Insights & improvement: Monitor engagement and use insights to continuously improve our internal communications.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Current Bachelor’s or Master’s studies in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Business or a related field, with enrollment for the full duration of the internship.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to create clear and engaging content.

  • Strong interest in internal communications, employee engagement and organizational culture.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with colleagues across different teams.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint and SharePoint.

  • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship from 15 February 2027 onwards.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

  • An inspiring international work environment in a fast growing and innovative industry.

  • A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office/remote) working arrangements.

  • A monthly internship allowance of 800 euros.

  • Commuting travel reimbursement.

  • Paid Volunteering Day.

  • Access to our electric company boat, free lunches, and social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to ensuring every applicant has a fair chance, irrespective of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: wo-stage Economie & Data-analyse: onderzoek naar omzetverwachting
description:
wo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Duik jij graag in data om patronen en verbanden te ontdekken?
Krijg je energie van statistisch onderzoek en wil je ontdekken wat bedrijfsverwachtingen ons vertellen over de economie? 

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden:

  • Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen.

  • Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken.

Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! 

Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen:

  • Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen?

  • Wat vinden belanghebbende op dit gebied hiervan?

  • Hoe kunnen we intern deze verbanden inzetten om verdachte opgaven in andere enquêtes en bronnen te detecteren? 

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Het team Bedrijvenconjunctuur & Coördinatie bestaat uit ongeveer 25 medewerkers. Variërend van zeer ervaren medewerkers tot jonge mensen die nog aan het begin van hun loopbaan staan. We werken met elkaar op een collegiale en professionele manier aan statistieken over het bedrijfsleven die voor beleidmakers en journalisten er echt toe doen!
Tijdens je stage heb je ook regelmatig contact en werk je samen met collega’s van de andere teams binnen de sector Bedrijvenstatistieken in Den Haag.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een wetenschappelijke opleiding met als studierichting economie, bedrijfseconomie, statistiek of dataverwerking.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Statistiek;

  • Python en/of R;

  • Bedrijfseconomische begrippen zoals omzet, bedrijfsgrootte, rechtvorm en indexcijfers.

Je bent een enthousiaste en proactieve student die flexibel inspeelt op verschillende situaties. Je bent sociaal, weet tactvol te handelen en werkt graag samen met anderen om tot een goed resultaat te komen.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw onderzoek vaardigheden vergroot;

  • ervaring opdoet met statistische en economische concepten;

  • leert om begrijpelijk te programmeren in R/Python;

  • jouw communicatieve vaardigheden verder ontwikkelt zodat je de uitkomsten van jouw onderzoek optimaal presenteert en de boodschap helder overkomt.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
  • Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
  • Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 1 year of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
  • Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
  • Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
  • Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
  • Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
  • Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
  • Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
  • Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
  • Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
  • Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
  • Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
  • Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
  • Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
  • Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

description:
NetDocuments is committed to providing an excellent candidate experience and will never ask you to engage in recruitment activity without phone, video, and in person meetings and communications from emails using the @netdocuments.com domain. If you have any concerns or questions about communications you have received, please send them to hrgroup@netdocuments.com so our team members can review.

About NetDocuments

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

  • Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
  • Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace
  • Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

About the Opportunity

NetDocuments is seeking a Technical Trainer with a passion for technology, enablement, and legal industry transformation. This role will deliver comprehensive product and implementation program training to NetDocuments Customer Success, with a growing emphasis on AI capabilities and legal-specific workflows. The Technical Trainer will play a critical role in shaping how customers understand and apply our solutions, particularly in legal, compliance, and professional services environments.

Reporting to the Sr Director of Partner Success, this role requires not only technical training acumen but also a solid understanding of legal operations, AI-powered document management, and the evolving needs of law firms and legal departments.

What Your Contributions Will Be:

  • Facilitate multi-day training programs (virtual and onsite) across global time zones with legal-industry contextual examples.
  • Collaborate with the Partner Enablement team to design and continuously improve course materials that incorporate AI features, legal-specific workflows, and best practices.
  • Ensure follow-through and program completion with personalized support, coaching, and learning journeys.
  • Stay current on NetDocuments AI functionality, emerging legal technology trends, and legal use cases to keep training highly relevant and practical.
  • Act as a liaison for customers, coordinating across internal teams to resolve issues, representing customer needs, and ensuring aligned support throughout the implementation process.
  • Present confidently to customers and internal stakeholders in meetings, project updates, and briefings.
  • Support strategic business outcomes, including Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), and training delivery KPIs.

What You Will Bring to the Team:

  • A deep understanding of how legal professionals use technology, including document management systems, AI-driven search, and workflow automation.
  • The ability to translate technical functionality into business value, particularly in law firms, legal operations, compliance, or corporate legal departments.
  • A learner-first mindset—balancing clarity, empathy, and impact in every training session.
  • Skills in knowledge transfer and curriculum development with an eye toward legal relevance and customer success.

Required Education and Experience:

  • 3+ years of proven experience as a technical trainer or in a technical enablement role.
  • Experience using and training AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Chat GPT)
  • Strong presentation skills and comfort with delivering training to diverse audiences, including legal professionals.
  • Familiarity with modern learning tools and training techniques, including the use of LMS platforms, video modules, and performance-based assessment.

title: Sales Development Representative (Graduate/Junior) - 4 Day Week + Remote
description:
No sales experience? Good. That's not what we're hiring for.

Most people you'll call didn't ask to hear from you. They're running construction sites, chasing programmes and fighting fires, and they'll give you about ten seconds to prove you're worth two minutes. Earn those two minutes, find a real problem, and you'll be opening doors at some of the UK's biggest construction firms.

You don't need a sales CV for this. You need to be curious, resilient and genuinely coachable. We'll teach you the rest, with a proper 90-day plan, a coach alongside you every week, and a playbook built from the calls that are actually winning.

It won't always be easy, but you'll learn faster than almost anywhere else. If you'd rather be genuinely good at sales in two years than comfortable in two months, keep reading.

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

_________________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined.

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has:

  • Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that:

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions:

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

You're where every Shape deal starts: finding the right people at construction firms and booking qualified meetings that turn into free launches and contracts. It's a role for someone who wants to learn sales properly, from the ground up, in a team that cares about doing it well.

What the job actually is

Most of your day, every day, is on the phone. You'll be calling commercial, project and operations leaders at tier 1 and tier 2 construction firms (main contractors and the subcontractors who work for them). They're running live projects, their time is precious and they're wary of anyone selling software. You'll hear "no", "not now" and "just send me an email" a lot. Almost all of our pipeline is outbound, apart from customer referrals, so the meetings you book are ones you've created yourself.

Quality over quantity, always. We care about the work we do and take pride in doing it properly, and we're looking for people who feel the same. On the phone, that starts with a real conversation, not a script. It means being curious enough to ask the second and third question, listening more than you talk, and caring more about understanding someone's world than getting a calendar invite out of them. By the end of the call, you should know what's actually going wrong for them, on which project, and why it matters now. Then you only offer a solution to people who genuinely want or need to fix it. If they don't, that's fine: you thank them and move on. Get that right and the meeting follows naturally, and it's one worth having.

How the team is set up

You'll sit in the UK sales team, working day to day with an Account Executive who takes your meetings forward to a free launch and then a contract. You open the door, they win the deal, and you succeed together. You'll work with a CRM, a dialler and call recording, plus a playbook, a library of calls that have actually won, and AI call-prep tools built for how we sell.

Where you'll work

Remote, anywhere in the UK, with the chance to attend industry events in person in the near future.

Why it's worth it

  • A career in a market that's only just going digital: around $10 trillion is spent on construction every year, yet it's one of the least digitised industries in the world, and spending on construction management software is forecast to nearly double by 2030. People who can sell software and genuinely understand construction are rare. Learn both here, and you'll have skills that stay in demand for years as the industry catches up, and you'll be helping it work better along the way.
  • Senior conversations from the start: you'll be speaking directly to leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms, not working your way through gatekeepers.
  • Coaching that knows the industry: weekly reviews and coaching from people who've lived and breathed construction, on site, not just on the phones.
  • A playbook that works: built from calls that have won, so you're not starting from scratch.
  • Progression on merit: a proper conversation about your next step within a year, based on what you've shown.
  • You'll shape how we sell: what you learn and suggest makes it into the playbook.
  • A 4-day week: the same standards and targets, delivered in four days.

Your top responsibilities

  • Open doors: start proper conversations, every day, with the people who feel the problem and can decide.
  • Qualify properly: test the problem early, dig in before you pitch, and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Hand over cleanly: your CRM notes tell the story, so your Account Executive picks up exactly where you left off.
  • Be obsessed with your numbers: know them every day, track them weekly and act on what they tell you.

Your roadmap: your first year

Your first 90 days combine structured onboarding with a reduced target, so you learn properly before you're measured at full pace.

  • Before day 1, ready to go: every tool set up and working, so week 1 is spent learning, not setting up.
  • Month 1, learn the why: how construction projects run and where they lose money, what Shape does about it, and the language of the industry. Listen to every call in our library, write your first-call pitch, role-play daily, and make your first supervised calls when you're ready.
  • Month 2, practise live: on the phones every day, with call reviews alongside you. We judge you on the quality of your conversations, not volume, as you book your first meetings.
  • Month 3, build consistency: building up to a full day of calling and booking regularly. Across your first three months, you work to half the full target.
  • From month 4, full target: the same target every SDR carries.
  • Months 4–6, make it consistent: the rest of your probation is about hitting that target month after month, with your own scorecard and weekly 1:1s.
  • Around 12 months, what's next: a progression conversation about Senior SDR or Account Executive, based on what you've shown, not how long you've been here.

Why three months is realistic: it's fast compared with most sales teams, and that's deliberate. You won't be learning just from trial and error. You'll have a structured onboarding, a playbook built from calls that have won, daily call reviews early on, weekly 1:1s and your own scorecard. Our best have been fully up to speed in a month. You will make mistakes, and that's fine. You won't be thrown in at the deep end.

How you'll be measured

Good numbers come from good conversations. You'll have your own monthly scorecard, built around three questions: are you reaching the right people, are those calls turning into real conversations, and are those conversations turning into meetings worth having?

Your main target is qualified meetings attended: meetings that actually take place, where your Account Executive agrees there's a genuine opportunity. You'll know your numbers from day one, and we'll go through them with you every week.

No grey areas: you and your Account Executive are partners. What makes a meeting qualified is written down and shared, so you'll both know where the bar is. If you ever see one differently, you talk it through with the call recording in front of you. Decisions come down to facts, never opinion or politics.

What our best are doing: booking around 20% more meetings than target, turning conversations into meetings at nearly double the minimum rate, and keeping more people on the phone than our standard asks for, with almost every meeting qualified (92%) because they do the basics properly. That's the bar, and we'll help you get there.

A start-up at a pivotal point

If you've ever wanted to join a start-up right as it takes off, this is that moment. We're past the early days: our sales process is working, customers are launching with us and we know what good looks like. Now we're growing, and the people who join now will shape what comes next.

You get the start-up stuff, the exciting and the real: things move fast, you'll build as you go, your ideas get heard (and actually used), and you'll see the impact of your work every week. We hold ourselves to a high standard, back each other up and enjoy it along the way.

We're looking for people in it for the long term, and that works both ways. We'll invest in you with weekly coaching, structured training and progression on merit. In return, we want people who want to build something with us over years, not a stepping stone.

Your Capabilities

Why experience isn't everything

Sales skills can be taught. Attitude is much harder to teach, and bad habits are harder to unlearn than good ones are to learn. We'd rather hire someone hungry who gets better on every call than someone with three years of bad habits. So whether you're just finishing your studies or already have a year or two in sales or a customer-facing role, this is the role for you. If you have 2+ years of outbound B2B behind you, take a look at our Senior SDR role instead.

What we look for instead

  • A forever learner: you never feel you know enough. You're always looking for the next thing to learn, and you go after it.
  • A sponge, with no ego: you soak everything up, take feedback and actually change what you do on the next call, and never think you're above the basics.
  • Resilient and disciplined: you can hear "no" twenty times before lunch and still mean it on call twenty-one. You've stuck at something hard and kept showing up when it got tough, whether that's competitive sport, music, a part-time job alongside your studies, volunteering or a society you helped run.
  • Curious, and a genuine listener: you ask the second question and listen to understand, not to wait for your turn. Construction people can spot a fake a mile off, and so can we.
  • Quick on your feet: calls rarely go word perfect. You think creatively, react to what's actually been said, and speak plainly and confidently. You don't need to be loud, just credible.
  • A strategist who takes action: you think about who to call, when and why, then get on with it without waiting to be told. You listen to calls and practise before anyone asks you to.
  • You've done your homework: you understand, at a high level, the problems people in construction face, and you can clearly say why construction and why this job. "My dad's an electrician" is a start, not an answer.

Nice to have (if you don't have it now, you will after joining)

  • Any sales or customer-facing experience, such as retail, hospitality or recruitment, especially where you had targets to hit.
  • A competitive streak, mostly with yourself.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-growing business.
  • Experience using a CRM, a dialler or other sales tools.
  • Any construction site experience, through work, a placement or an apprenticeship.

Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You'd rather set the strategy and have someone else build the campaigns
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on booked demos
  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

Apply with your CV and a cover letter answering these three questions. We care much more about your answers than your CV.

  1. Why construction, and why this job?
  2. What do you think are the biggest problems facing the people we'd have you calling?
  3. What's something you've stuck at, even when it got hard, and what did it teach you?

A note on AI: yes, we use it every day, and you're welcome to use it to research or sharpen your thinking. But right now this is about getting to know you, so make sure your answers sound like you. There are no wrong answers. We'd rather hear what you really think, even if it's not completely accurate.

What happens next

Every application is read by the people you'd work with. We move quickly, and you'll hear back at every stage. After an initial screen, there are three stages:

  • Meet and greet: we get to know each other and make sure we're aligned on expectations, both yours and ours.
  • Mock call with feedback: a role-play cold call. We'll give you feedback and see how you use it. We'll prepare you for this, and nobody expects it to be perfect.
  • Meet the team, then a decision: meet the people you'd be working with every day. Then we'll give you a clear answer either way, with feedback.

Compensation

Additional Information
