description:
Who we are

At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What we are building

Our Professional Services team designs and delivers the architectures and integrations that embed Domino into our customers’ IT landscapes. As Solution Architects, we embed Domino into the most complex enterprise IT landscapes on the planet — hybrid cloud, on-prem, air-gapped, regulated — and turn what we see in the field into a sharper product.

What your impact will be

  • Lead technical execution on Domino's most strategic F100 deployments — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hybrid — powering enterprise AI/ML at scale.
  • Design end-to-end reference architectures that hold up in regulated environments across data, identity, security, and infrastructure.
  • Build and document field integrations across the AI/ML ecosystem (data platforms, model registries, MLOps tooling), then enable the rest of Solutions on them.
  • Partner with account and SE teams on scoping, custom demos, and PoCs that map to real customer AI use cases — not generic ones.
  • Translate what you see in the field into roadmap input Product and Engineering actually act on.

What we look for in this role

  • 5+ years hands-on with Kubernetes in production — upgrades, migrations, multi-region DR, cluster management at scale.
  • End-to-end enterprise K8s implementations in the wild, cloud or on-prem (OpenShift a strong signal). PoCs and Terraform-only don't count.
  • Direct experience owning strategic customer relationships at CTO / platform-lead level, not one step below.
  • Hands-on with at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — Azure a strong plus — and comfort translating security and compliance requirements into architectures that pass audit.
  • Hands-on AI/ML or data platform experience (Domino or comparable MLOps tooling), especially in regulated environments — a strong plus.

What we value

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply
  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
  • We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work

title: (787) HR Analyst
description:
Company Summary

Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future.

Position Overview

The HR Analyst plays a critical role in supporting end-to-end HR service delivery, including providing analytical, operational, and coordination support across Personnel Administration, Benefits, Payroll coordination, as well as Onboarding and Offboarding activities. This role is responsible for running and analyzing HR reports, tracking HR KPIs, supporting coordination between HR and Talent Acquisition for seamless handoffs, facilitating day-to-day HR operations, and ensuring data accuracy and process consistency across HR systems.

The HR Analyst partners closely with HR leadership, Recruitment, Payroll, and Program stakeholders to support day-to-day HR operations while enabling data-driven decision-making across the employee lifecycle.

Work Location: Washington, D.C. area (remote)

Clearance: N/A

Job Responsibilities and/or Success Factors

HR Operations & Service Delivery

  • Support end-to-end HR service delivery across personnel actions, employee lifecycle changes, and HR transactions.
  • Coordinate closely with Payroll to ensure accurate processing of hires, terminations, changes, and audits.
  • Assist with benefits administration coordination, including eligibility tracking, enrollments, and employee inquiries.
  • Support general HR inquiries and conduct research of policies and procedures, as needed.
  • Maintain accurate employee data across HR systems and ensure compliance with internal policies and applicable regulations.
  • Support onboarding, offboarding, and employee documentation processes in partnership with HR leadership.
  • Partner with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to ensure hiring processes are followed and timelines are met.

HR Reporting, Analytics & KPIs

  • Run standard and ad-hoc HR reports related to headcount, turnover, hiring activity, benefits, and workforce trends.
  • Track and maintain HR and Talent Acquisition KPIs (e.g., time-to-fill, pipeline metrics, hiring volume, retention, turnover, and other workforce data).
  • Support HR dashboards and reporting for leadership, ensuring data integrity and consistency.
  • Assist with audits, data validation, and reconciliation across HR, ATS, and payroll systems.

Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Support

  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, workflows, and reporting efficiency.
  • Support documentation of HR procedures, SOPs, and job aids.
  • Serve as a liaison between HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, I.T., PMO and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery.
  • Provide responsive, professional support to employees and managers on HR-related inquiries.

Education and Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Management, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in HR operations, HR analytics, or a related HR role.

title: Account Executive - Japan
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is hiring a senior Account Executive to drive customer acquisition and growth across Japan. This is a strategic hunter role, focused on expanding adoption of our AI and cloud platform with new and existing customers in the region.

You will own complex, high-value sales cycles end to end—building executive relationships, uncovering new opportunities, working closely with partners, and closing deals that drive long-term customer value. Success in this role requires strong consultative selling skills, the ability to translate complex business needs into tailored solutions, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution and will play a key role in helping customers unlock the full potential of Nebius’ AI and cloud offerings.

As a core member of our founding Japan business team, you will have the opportunity to help shape the foundations of our culture and operations while working remotely and being based in the Greater Tokyo Area.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and grow your territory: Build and execute a strategic territory plan, delivering against revenue and growth targets.
  • Negotiation & closing: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations with C-suite and senior decision-makers, closing deals that support long-term partnerships.
  • Solution selling: Demonstrate the value of Nebius’ AI and cloud platform through consultative discovery, tailored presentations, and product demonstrations.
  • Client engagement: Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders across the enterprise, aligning solutions to customer-specific challenges and outcomes.
  • Team orchestration: Partner closely with Sales Engineers, Industry Specialists, Partners, and Customer Success to deliver differentiated value propositions.
  • Forecasting & execution: maintain strong forecast accuracy and delivering against ACV and activity targets.
  • Market presence: Represent Nebius at regional and industry events, webinars, and customer forums.
  • Subject matter expertise: Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to position our solutions effectively.

We expect you to have:

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in AI, cloud, data infrastructure, or related technologies.
  • A proven track record of exceeding sales targets, generating pipeline, and maintaining forecast accuracy.
  • Experience selling cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), AI solutions, or complex enterprise technologies.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including value-based selling, executive storytelling, negotiation, and multi-year deal structuring.
  • A genuine interest in working in a high-growth, startup environment, with a desire to directly impact company growth.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the region as needed.
  • Language: Native Japanese & Business level English

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Prior experience in a high-growth or early-stage startup environment.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. description:
Overview

The Lifeway Internship Program is a unique opportunity designed to provide college students and recent graduates with a valuable learning experience that fosters growth both professionally, personally, and spiritually. Our internships go far beyond "busy work"—you’ll engage in meaningful projects, gain hands-on experience, and be empowered to make an impact. Interns at Lifeway receive professional development, have opportunities for exposure to senior leaders, and benefit from mentoring relationships with experts in their chosen field.

Job Overview

This internship involves developing market research and strategy skills while helping promote Lifeway Adult Bible studies and craft marketing messaging for New Year campaigns aimed at the discipleship leader in churches. You will complete a competitive analysis or dig into customer data by segment and church size, then recommend strategy and campaign ideas to the team.

Internship Program Details & Requirements

  • Compensation: Lifeway’s summer internship program offers a competitive hourly pay rate, and all necessary equipment is provided.
  • Work Schedule: Interns work an average of 32 hours per week, with core workdays from Tuesday to Thursday. The expectation is that the internship is the primary focus during working hours.
  • Program Duration: June 7 - August 11, 2027 (11 weeks). Interns must commit to participating in the entire program.
  • Eligibility: Candidates must be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and have completed at least two years of study by the internship start date. Recent graduates (December 2026 or May 2027) are also eligible.
  • Development Opportunities: Weekly professional development sessions are provided, including specialized training, mentorship, and leadership development.
  • Remote Structure: This is a remote position in the U.S., with required in-person attendance for orientation (June 7 - 11, 2027) and end-of-summer presentations (August 9-11, 2027) in Nashville. Travel costs for these events are covered by Lifeway.
  • Application Deadline: Applications are due by December 31, with interviews beginning as soon as possible. Selections are finalized by April 1.

Explore our culture further at team.lifeway.com/culture-code

This is a remote position based in the contiguous 48 United States with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team gatherings.

Responsibilities

  • Live out Lifeway’s mission and values, showing deep commitment to Kingdom work
  • Assist with planning, scheduling and execution of marketing campaigns.
  • Complete competitive analysis of how other publishers promote backlist Bible study titles.
  • Analyze customer data by segment and church size to learn when and what each size buys.

Qualifications

Education

Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing or a related field (rising junior or senior, recent graduate, or enrolled graduate student), required

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, required

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

Actively involved in an evangelical Christian church

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, preferred

• Experience in market research and formulating marketing plans

• Familiarity with Lifeway

title: M&A Associate
description:
Job Description:

M&A Associate

Compensation & Role Details:

Expected Salary Range: The expected salary range for this role is between $70,000 – $90,000 CAD , depending on experience and qualifications

Role Type: New Role

AI Disclosure: AI may be used during the hiring process.

About CORA Banking & Financial Services Group:

CORA Banking & Financial Services Group is a division of CORA Group, part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), the world’s most prolific acquirer of vertical market software businesses. We buy and hold software companies that serve banks, credit unions, lenders, collection agencies and enterprise financial institutions, and we never sell them. Our focus areas are core and digital banking, payments, lending and credit, debt collection and recovery, risk and compliance, and financial operations and analytics. PhoenixWorx, acquired from Finastra in 2026, anchors the group alongside a growing portfolio including WebRecon and CORA Loyalty. We give founders a permanent home for their business, their people and their customers, and we give our team the chance to learn acquisitions inside the Constellation model, disciplined pricing, long-term ownership, and a seat at the table on every deal.

Job Profile (Location – USA/Canada, flexible):

Title: M&A Associate

Location: USA or Canada, flexible

Reports to: Vice President, M&A

Start: January 2027

The Associate builds and works our acquisition pipeline. You identify and research software businesses in our verticals, open relationships with founders and owners, qualify opportunities against our investment criteria, and bring the ones that fit to our twice-weekly deal review with a clear thesis. You own a defined territory of accounts, keep it current in Salesforce, and are measured on the quality of the conversations you create and the deals you move to an offer. You’ll learn how a Constellation acquirer screens, prices and buys software businesses, with a path to the modelling and deal-execution side as you progress.


What you’ll do:


  • Own a territory of target accounts across core and digital banking, payments, lending, debt collection and recovery, risk and compliance, and loyalty; research, prioritise and work it systematically.
  • Reach out to founders and owners by phone, email and in person; hold roughly five to ten substantive founder conversations a week once ramped.
  • Qualify opportunities against our criteria (revenue scale, recurring revenue, vertical fit, geography) using our screening tools, and log every interaction in Salesforce to CSI standards.
  • Write a one-page thesis for each opportunity you advance and present it at deal review.
  • Nurture long-cycle relationships with owners who aren’t ready to sell yet.
  • Support conference and event work: pre-show target lists, meeting booking, on-site coordination and post-show follow-up.
  • Work with the Senior Associate and VP on the early stages of modelling and diligence as opportunities progress.
  • Keep your pipeline current in our deal-workflow system.

Qualifications

Required:


  • 2 to 4 years in business development, sales development, corporate development, investment banking analyst work, or a research or sourcing role at an acquirer.
  • Demonstrated comfort with outbound outreach and high-volume relationship building; you’re not put off by cold calls.
  • Ability to read a software company quickly: what it does, who it sells to, how it makes money, whether it fits.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; you’ll be the first voice many founders hear from us.
  • Organised and disciplined about CRM hygiene and follow-up.
  • Eligible to work in Canada or the United States.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to B2B software, fintech, banking or collections.
  • Salesforce experience.
  • Basic financial literacy (recurring revenue, EBITDA, margins) and an interest in moving toward M&A execution.
  • A second language relevant to our markets.

Compensation and benefits:

  • Base salary within the posted range, set by experience and location.
  • MBO bonus tied to qualified founder conversations and opportunities advanced to an approved offer, with a quality condition so volume alone doesn’t pay.
  • Health, dental and vision benefits; retirement plan with employer match (RRSP in Canada, 401(k) in the US); paid vacation and personal days.
  • Remote work; Toronto office presence expected one to two days a quarter for Toronto-based hires.
  • Training in Constellation’s acquisition model and a defined path to Senior Associate, M&A.
  • Travel: approximately 20%, primarily to industry conferences and trade shows across North America, with occasional travel to meet target companies alongside the VP.

Business Unit:

CORA M&A

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Job Title: Associate Tutor - Medical Devices

Location: Poland

About BSI:


In BSI, our ambition is to be recognized and valued globally as a best-in-class company; a client-driven, efficiently-run, growing business. BSI has come a long way since being founded in 1901.

Today, we’re a global business services organization, respected world over for the development of standards; auditing of management systems; testing and certification of products and services; providing software solutions; and the delivery of training courses. We offer diverse career paths from auditing to sales, product development to finance, and from IT to marketing.

With over 5,000 employees in more than 182 countries, this provides vast huge career opportunities that best suited individual’s growth interest. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. We pride ourselves on the expertise, integrity and professionalism of our people. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk and achieve sustainable growth.


Purpose of the position

The Associate Tutor is an independent training professional engaged on an assignment basis to deliver high-quality instructor-led training courses on behalf of BSI across relevant standards and schemes, including but not limited to ISO 13485, ISO 7101, and other designated management systems. The role is responsible for facilitating engaging and effective learning experiences, maintaining the integrity and quality of course delivery, and ensuring compliance with BSI's training methodologies, accreditation requirements, and client expectations. Associate Tutors represent BSI professionally while contributing their subject matter expertise to support the development of customer competence and organizational capability.


Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities


Associate Tutor Leadership

  • Deliver instructor-led (ILT) and virtual instructor-led (VILT) training courses on assigned standards and schemes (e.g. ISO 13485, ISO 7101, IHC 1, IHC 2 and others) in accordance with BSI methodologies, accreditation requirements, and course specifications.
  • Prepare thoroughly for each training assignment by reviewing course materials, delivery plans, learner information, and any client-specific requirements.
  • Facilitate engaging, interactive, and inclusive learning environments that encourage participant involvement and knowledge transfer.
  • Adapt training delivery to meet the needs, experience levels, and learning styles of diverse audiences while maintaining course integrity.
  • Conduct examinations, practical activities, workshops, and assessments in accordance with applicable accreditation and examination body requirements.
  • Ensure the consistent and accurate use of BSI-approved training materials, tools, platforms, and learning technologies.
  • Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, impartiality, ethics, and confidentiality when representing BSI.
  • Comply with all BSI policies, procedures, quality requirements, safeguarding principles, and health, safety, and information security requirements.
  • Complete all required course administration, attendance records, examination documentation, expense claims, and post-course reports accurately and within agreed timeframes.
  • Respond professionally to learner questions while remaining within the scope of the approved course content and personal competence.
  • Maintain current technical knowledge of assigned standards, regulations, and industry best practices through continuous professional development.
  • Participate in tutor standardisation activities, calibration sessions, coaching, observations, and quality assurance reviews as requested.
  • Provide feedback on course materials and recommend improvements to enhance learner experience and training effectiveness.
  • Maintain relevant professional qualifications, certifications, and competencies required to deliver assigned courses.
  • Collaborate effectively with BSI Training Operations and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality customer experience before, during, and after course delivery.
  • Promote and protect BSI's reputation by delivering an exceptional customer experience and acting as a professional ambassador for the organisation.

Act as a brand Ambassador for BSI. This means acting ethically, following company rules and promoting BSI services to clients so they are able to optimize business performance.

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About the Role

As a Founding Engineer at SANOVIO, you will play a key role in building the AI-powered procurement infrastructure that tackles one of the biggest and most complex cost problems in European healthcare.

This is a fast-paced, hands-on role for engineers with high agency, strong technical depth, and a founder mindset. We’re looking for a full-stack generalist with a strong frontend affinity. You excel at designing user flows and implementing them in React and TypeScript, while owning outcomes end-to-end across backend, data, AI-enabled workflows, and cloud deployment. You thrive amid uncertainty and incomplete requirements, move quickly, and still care deeply about architecture, clean code, and long-term quality.

If you are a passionate builder who thrives at the intersection of full-stack development and AI, this is your opportunity to work closely with the founders, shape the product, and help us scale toward €10M ARR in 2026.

Tasks

  • Owning end-to-end product workflows, from frontend UX to backend systems, data pipelines, and edge cases

  • Building world-class frontend experiences in React and TypeScript alongside scalable, reliable backend systems

  • Designing and owning AI-enabled systems, including embeddings, retrieval, and agents that create real operational leverage

  • Developing and operating data pipelines for large-scale unstructured data

  • Making pragmatic technical decisions on architecture, tools, and frameworks to balance speed and quality

  • Deploying, running, and maintaining software in cloud environments with a “you ship it, you run it” mindset

  • Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code with scalable, reusable components and APIs

  • Collaborating across the stack and raising the engineering bar through reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership

General Profile

We are looking for stellar engineers with a strong background in full-stack software engineering and AI, and the potential to grow and lead teams in the future. 3–5 years of experience is a plus, but we hire for skill, ownership, and output.

  • Generalist engineer with a frontend affinity, capable of building across backend, data, and AI

  • End-to-end product ownership, driving ideas from concept to customer-ready production

  • Proactive execution in ambiguous environments, turning unclear requirements into shipped software

  • High-speed delivery paired with a focus on clean code and scalable architecture

  • Close iteration with users and clients, including collaboration across different cultures

  • Strong problem-solving ability and fast adoption of new technologies

  • Motivation to build excellent software in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Willingness to work in-person in Munich with a higher intensity than a traditional 9–5 role

Technical skillset

  • Strong experience with full-stack software engineering, especially React and TypeScript, with excellent understanding of constructing user flows

  • Solid backend engineering skills, ideally with Node.js, and experience designing APIs and data model

  • Proven track record of architecting and building production-grade software systems

  • Cloud and DevOps experience with Docker

  • AI experience is a plus, especially embeddings and retrieval, structured outputs and tool calling, evals, and agentic workflows beyond prompt engineering

Leadership and communication

  • You naturally take responsibility and enjoy leading

  • You’re one of the strongest engineers in the team and make everyone else better

  • Everyone can come to you for advice on how to fix their hardest problems

  • You communicate clearly and are credible with technical stakeholders and clients

Bonus if you

  • Can share a portfolio of projects, shipped products, or a GitHub with meaningful work

  • Have experience scaling systems from early usage to larger production workloads

  • Have built workflow-heavy B2B products, internal tools, or operations software

  • You are business proficient in Chinese

Benefits

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly Wellness budget

  • Access to any AI or productivity tools you need to do your best work

  • International scope & travel

  • Flexible work setup with time-zone responsibility

  • Meaningful compensation package including cash, performance bonus, and shares (Actual offers and compensation are based on specific job duties, experience, performance, total rewards structure, and other considerations).


About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro meeting with one of the founders to get to know each other and introduce SANOVIO.

Step 2: Technical interview

The technical interview consists of two parts:

  • A take-home exercise, including a short presentation

  • A system design interview

For the take-home exercise, we’d provide you with a task. You’ll have 2–3 hours to complete it, focusing on a real SANOVIO workflow and user flow in React and TypeScript, with a light end-to-end angle such as API integration, data modeling, edge cases, and clean architecture. Later, you’ll present your results to us.

Step 3: Personal Fit

Meet another co-founder to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & Reference Checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. At the same time, we’ll ask you to provide 2–3 references so we can gather additional insights into your strengths and working style.

title: Content Reviewer - United States
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMastâ¢ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing networkâcombining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermasterâs SmartMastâ¢ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

  • Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations (8D, 5-Whys, Fishbone) for manufacturing non-conformances, test failures, and field/customer returns.

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

  • Track, analyze, and report key quality metrics (yield, defect rates, RMA/field return trends, supplier performance) to drive measurable reductions in defects and hardware rework.

  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Bachelorâs degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Quality Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3â5+ years of experience in quality engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

  • Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.

Work Environment:

  • Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

  • Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customerâs broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read thisÂ blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) im Bereich Workshop- und Ehrenamtsmanagement (Frankfurt/Rhein-Main)
description:
Die Stelle in Kürze

Wir bei Kopfsachen vermitteln in verschiedenen Bildungsformaten die Grundlagen der mentalen Gesundheitskompetenz. Unsere Mission ist es, mentale Gesundheit für junge Menschen verständlich und zugänglich zu machen. Als Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) im Bereich Workshop- und Ehrenamtsmanagement erhältst du einen vielseitigen Einblick in unsere operative Arbeit, von der Organisation unserer Workshops bis zur Unterstützung unseres ehrenamtlichen Workshopleitungs-Teams. Du sorgst mit Struktur, Kommunikationsgeschick und Freude an der Teamarbeit dafür, dass unsere Workshops organisatorisch reibungslos ablaufen und junge Menschen von unserer Arbeit profitieren.

  • Standort: Frankfurt 
  • Arbeitszeit: 10h pro Woche 
  • Startdatum: 01. Januar
  • Vorerst befristet auf 1 Jahr


Deine Mission

Als Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) im Bereich Workshop- und Ehrenamtsmanagement trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Workshops an Schulen in Frankfurt und Rhein-Main-Gebiet professionell vorbereitet, begleitet und nachbereitet werden. Mit deinem Blick für Prozesse und Organisation trägst du zur Etablierung des jungen Standortes bei. Dabei verfolgst du das Ziel, mentale Gesundheitskompetenz an Schulen zu stärken.


Deine Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben umfassen unter anderem:

  • Koordination & Kommunikation: 
    • Unterstützung bei der organisatorischen Vorbereitung von Workshops
    • Prüfen, ob alle relevanten Informationen für die Workshopleitungen vorliegen und richtig im System hinterlegt sind.
    • Betreuung und Koordination neuer Workshopleitungen im Rahmen ihres Onboardings und darüber hinaus.
    • Bereitstellung des Feedbacks von Schülerinnen und Schülern
    • Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung und Gestaltung von Teamtreffen
  • Rechercheaufträge und Netzwerkpflege:
    • Zuarbeit im Bereich Schulakquise, z. B. Recherche bestimmter Schulprogramme, aktueller politischer Entwicklungen und Vorbereitung von Rundmails.
    • Zuarbeit im Bereich Fundraising, z. B. Recherche potentieller neuer regionaler Förderpartner und aktueller Ausschreibungen; Verfassen von Projektberichten etc.
  • Administrative Aufgaben:
    • Prüfung von Abrechnungen und Nachweisen.
    • Ausstellung von Ehrenamtsbescheinigungen.


Dein Profil

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, gewissenhaft und selbstständig auch in remote-Settings.
  • Du hast Freude an Admin- und Organisation, Kommunikation und Teamarbeit.
  • Du bist im Studium eingeschrieben (mindestens noch 1 Jahr) – Studiengänge mit psychologischem und/oder pädagogischem-Bezug sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Du bringst eine hohe Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.
  • Du wohnst in Frankfurt oder Umgebung und hast Lust, regional zu wirken.  
  • Erste Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Bildung, Projektmanagement oder als Workshopleitung sind ein Plus.
  • Du hast bereits erste Arbeitserfahrungen mit unterschiedlichen Projektmanagement-Tools gesammelt.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1).


Unser Angebot

  • Eine bedeutungsvolle Mission: Du arbeitest an einer Aufgabe, die wirklich einen Unterschied im Leben junger Menschen macht.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & Eigenverantwortung: Raum für Mitgestaltung, Verantwortung und eigene Ideen.
  • Teamspirit & Wertschätzung: Offenes, unterstützendes Team mit regelmäßigem Feedback und engem Austausch.
  • Flexible Arbeitsweise: Kombination aus Arbeiten im Frankfurter Büro und Homeoffice.
  • Innovatives Umfeld: Ein junges Social Start-up mit viel Raum für Lernen und persönliche Entwicklung.
Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich alle qualifizierten Personen, sich bei uns zu bewerben – insbesondere Menschen mit Migrationsgeschichte, BIPoC, Menschen der LGBTQIA+ Community sowie Menschen mit Behinderungen. Wir freuen uns auch auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst.

title: IT Security Engineer / Security Architect (gn)
description:
Einleitung

Raum Hamburg | bis zu 60 % Remote | 75.000 - 90.000 € | Vollzeit
Wie etabliert man Sicherheitsstandards in einem internationalen Umfeld, ohne dabei den Blick für Betrieb, Cloud und Compliance zu verlieren?
Für ein international tätiges Unternehmen suchen wir einen erfahrenen IT-Security-Spezialisten (m/w/d), der operative und strategische Security-Themen gleichermaßen verantworten möchte. Im Fokus stehen der Ausbau moderner Sicherheitsarchitekturen, die Absicherung cloudbasierter Plattformen und die Weiterentwicklung konzernweiter Security-Standards.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Weiterentwicklung und Absicherung der globalen Security-Infrastruktur
  • Gestaltung moderner Cloud-Architekturen nach Zero-Trust-Prinzipien
  • Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Schutzbedarfsfeststellungen und Security-Architekturreviews
  • Planung und Umsetzung internationaler IT-Sicherheitsprojekte
  • Begleitung interner und externer Audits sowie Nachverfolgung von Maßnahmen
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Security-Richtlinien, Standards und Prozessen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Infrastruktur-, Netzwerk-, Cloud- und Applikationsteams bei Security-, Monitoring- und Incident-Response-Themen


Dein Profil

  • Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationssicherheit oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der operativen und konzeptionellen IT-Sicherheit
  • Kenntnisse in BSI IT-Grundschutz, NIST CSF und Risikobewertungen
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Netzwerk-, Perimeter- und Cloud-Security, idealerweise mit Azure oder Google Cloud
  • Praxiswissen in IAM, MFA, Zero Trust, Schwachstellenmanagement sowie Windows- und Linux-Security
  • Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Benefits

Du gestaltest Security nicht nur auf technischer Ebene, sondern wirkst aktiv an Sicherheitsarchitektur, Governance, Cloud Security und regulatorischen Anforderungen mit. Dabei arbeitest Du in einem internationalen Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und sichtbarem Einfluss auf die zukünftige Sicherheitsstrategie.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • 75.000 - 90.000 € Gehalt
  • Bis zu 60 % Remote Work
  • 30 Urlaubstage plus Urlaubsgeld
  • Erfolgsabhängige Bonuszahlungen
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Umfangreiche Weiterbildungsangebote
  • Deutschlandticket-Zuschuss und Bike-Leasing

title: Web Analyst & Tracking Expert (m/w/d)
description:
Wir möchten die Anlaufstelle für Google Ads & Web Analytics für E-Commerce Unternehmen mit einem großen Produktsortiment im DACH-Raum werden. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass viele Online-Shops noch nicht ihr volles Potenzial aufgrund von schlechter Betreuung ausschöpfen. Wir wollen das ändern.

Dabei legen wir bei uns einen großen Wert auf persönliche Entwicklung, operative und strategische Erstklassigkeit sowie Transparenz.

Wir wollen, dass sich alle unsere Teammitglieder fachlich und menschlich weiterentwickeln und so für außergewöhnlich gute Kundenergebnisse sorgen.

Um dies zu gewährleisten und unser Team auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir einen Web Analyst & Tracking Expert (m/w/d). Wenn Du Lust hast, unser Tracking Konzept weiterzuentwickeln und wertvolle Dashboards und Ad-Hoc Analysen zu erstellen, dann bist Du hier genau richtig!

Aufgaben

Als Web Analyst & Tracking Expert (m/w/d) bist Du dafür verantwortlich, dass unsere Kunden sowie unsere Performance Marketing Manager verlässliche Daten zur Optimierung erhalten. Aktuell ist unser Geschäftsführer für diesen Bereich zuständig und Du wirst ihn dabei unterstützen und diesen Bereich mit der Zeit übernehmen.

1. Web Tracking

  • Tracking Konzepte: Bevor Du mit einem Tracking startest, konzipierst und planst Du die Maßnahmen, die für den Kunden notwendig und sinnvoll sind.

  • Google Tag Manager: Du bist bei all unseren Projekten verantwortlich für den (Server) Google Tag Manager und erster Ansprechpartner für Deine Kollegen.

  • Server Side Tracking: Wir wollen das Maximum an Daten rausholen und implementieren daher bei all unseren Kunden Stape.

  • Debugging: Du findest eigenständig Fehler im Tracking Setup von Neu- und Bestandskunden und weißt, wie man die Probleme lösen kann.

2. Web Analytics

  • Google Analytics 4 & Microsoft Clarity: Du erstellst nicht nur das Tracking für unsere Kunden, sondern machst auch regelmäßige Analysen für die Kunden oder Deine Kollegen.

  • Data Studio: Du erstellst komplexe Berichte für externe oder interne Dashboards mit allen zur Verfügung stehenden Datenquellen.

3. Nice to have: Datenaufbereitung

  • Data Warehouse: Wir haben ein eigenes Data Warehouse, das noch weiter ausgebaut werden soll, um noch bessere Analysen erstellen zu können.

  • Interne Tools: Wir haben interne Tools, die auf dem DWH basieren und mithilfe von KI weiterentwickelt werden sollen.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Web Analytics, GA4, Google Tag Manager mit idealerweise einem starken Hintergrund im Agenturumfeld.

  • Hands-On Mentalität: wir sind ein kleines Team (aktuell 6 Personen) und es wird von Dir verlangt, dass Du sehr proaktiv arbeitest.

  • Technisches Tiefenwissen: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 und Microsoft Clarity sind Dein Zuhause. Du verstehst grundsätzlich Google Ads und Online Marketing und hast keine Scheu vor Skripten oder technischer Implementierung. Bonus wäre Erfahrung mit Server Side Tracking sowie mit anderen SEA spezifischen Tools.

  • Analytisches Mindset: Begriffe wie Attributionsmodelle, Consent Banner Anpassungen und Wettbewerbsanalysen sind für Dich tägliches Handwerkszeug.

  • Kundenorientierte, selbstständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Dienstleistungsorientierung.

  • Die Analyse und Auswertung von Daten gehören zu Deinen größten Stärken. Du erstellst sinnvolle Dashboards, wertest sie aus und kannst datengetriebene Aussagen treffen.

  • Dein selbstbewusstes Auftreten, Deine souveräne Art sowie starke Kommunikations Skills zeichnen Dich aus und machen Dich erfolgreich im in der Kundenbetreuung sowie im Kontakt mit Deinem Team.

  • Nice to have: Abgeschlossenes wirtschaftliches Studium und/ oder vergleichbarer Studiengang/ Ausbildung.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift (Deutsch ist zwingend notwendig, da der Kundenkontakt auf Deutsch ist).

  • Fester Wohnsitz in Deutschland.

Benefits

  • Erlebe eine wachsende Agentur hautnah und nutze die Möglichkeit, direkt an Entscheidungen beteiligt zu sein und aktiv mitzugestalten, anstatt in eingestaubten Strukturen gefangen zu sein.

  • Flache Hierarchien: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Sergej, dem Geschäftsführer.

  • Steile Lernkurve durch Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und durch unsere jahrelange Erfahrung im SEA und Web Analytics und jährlicher Besuch von Fachmessen oder Schulungen.

  • Lange Kundenbindung ermöglicht es, sich sehr tief mit unseren Kunden und ihren Prozessen auseinanderzusetzen, um gemeinsam mit den Kunden zu wachsen.

  • Qualität statt Quantität bei der Kundenanzahl.

  • Zugriff auf unser sehr umfangreiches internes Wissens Wiki.

  • Quartalsweise mehrtägige Meetings mit dem ganzen Team für gemeinsames Arbeiten, Workshops und Teambuilding Aktivitäten.

  • Ausstattung mit Apple MacBook, großem Bildschirm und hochwertigen Peripheriegeräten.

  • Home Office (innerhalb Deutschlands) mit der Option ins Büro in Hamburg zu kommen. Zusätzlich die Möglichkeit vereinzelt aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten - 39h Wochenarbeitszeit mit Kernarbeitszeiten von Mo. - Fr. 10:00 - 15:00.

  • Auch Teilzeitmodell möglich.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub + 1 Urlaubstag am Geburtstag + Halber Tag am 24. & 31.12 = Bis zu 32 Urlaubstage.

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft.

Wir wünschen uns auch, dass Du Deine Expertise einbringst und uns als Team weiterentwickelst. Der interne Austausch ist uns sehr wichtig, denn nur so ist ein gesundes menschliches und fachliches Wachstum möglich.

Nach Deiner Bewerbung möchten wir im ersten Schritt einen 45-minütigen Termin mit Dir vereinbaren, um einen ersten Eindruck zu gewinnen. Anschließend folgt eine Case Study. Auf dieser Basis laden wir Dich nach Hamburg ein, um das abschließende Gespräch zu führen.

title: Social Strategist (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass erfolgreiche Marken heute auf Social entstehen.

Genau hier setzen wir an und arbeiten mit den größten Influencern Deutschlands an neuen Formaten und Produkten. Gemeinsam mit Nona Kanal, Feli und vielen weiteren definieren wir die Creator Economy neu. Unser Team ist klein, entscheidet schnell, sitzt direkt mit den Gründern am Tisch und arbeitet nur mit einem ausgewählten Portfolio.

Unser Anspruch: Die größten Creator geführten Brands Europas aufbauen.

Was uns besonders macht:

  • Wir betreuen einige der spannendsten Community Brands im deutschsprachigen Raum.

  • Unsere Marken entstehen im engen Austausch mit Influencern. Wir kommunizieren über Social Media, Creator und echte Gesichter.

  • Unser kleines Team arbeitet schnell, direkt und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Flache Hierarchien ohne Konzernstrukturen, aber mit viel Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Unsere Ideen sollen nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern auffallen, weitererzählt werden und unsere Brands Schritt für Schritt größer machen.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Dataro

Dataro is a fast-growing tech company with a bold mission: set a new standard in charity fundraising. Our AI-driven SaaS tools help nonprofits raise more funds and make a bigger impact in the world. We work with more than 250 organisations across 20+ countries - including UNICEF, Greenpeace, Amnesty International and Save the Children - and we’re looking for someone to help us reach many more of them across the UK and Europe.

We closed a Series A funding round in February 2026, led by Blueprint Equity, and are investing that backing into growing the UK and European business.

About the Role

As our Sales Development Representative for the UK and Europe, you’ll be the first point of contact between Dataro and the fundraising leaders at large charities across the region. You’ll find the organisations with a problem worth solving, work out who inside them owns it, and open the conversations that let our Account Executives take things forward.

This is an outbound role and it sits at the front of everything we do commercially in the region. You’ll report directly to our Head of Region, UK & Europe, and work day to day alongside two Account Executives. You’ll own your own patch of target accounts across the UK and continental Europe.

This role is ideal for someone a few years into their sales career who wants a real patch rather than a script, and who is ready to move quickly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research and prioritise target charities across the UK and Europe, using our ideal customer criteria and live buying signals rather than working an undifferentiated list.

  • Run multi-channel outbound - email, LinkedIn and phone - leading with a relevant insight about the prospect’s fundraising programme, not a product pitch.

  • Map the buying group, identifying the fundraising managers, data leads and individual giving specialists who feel the problem day to day, and understanding how decisions actually get made inside each organisation.

  • Qualify hard and disqualify quickly. A fast no is more useful than a long maybe, for us and for the prospect.

  • Book and hand over qualified meetings, with enough context that the Account Executive walks in properly prepared.

  • Work across European markets, adapting your approach to local fundraising practice - the sector looks quite different in the Nordics, the Netherlands and the UK.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate - accounts, contacts, sequences, activity and notes.

  • Act as the voice of the market internally, feeding what you hear back to Sales, Marketing and Product. You’ll be closer to prospective customers than almost anyone else in the business.

Qualifications & Key Skills

  • 1–3 years’ experience in an outbound SDR or BDR role, ideally B2B SaaS.

  • Demonstrable track record of meeting and exceeding outbound activity and meeting targets.

  • AI Native - foundational understanding of AI-based efficiency tools (e.g. Claude), and a habit of using them.

  • Clear, plain written English. Most of your first impressions will be made in writing, and charity audiences respond badly to hype.

  • Comfortable with structure and discipline: sequences, activity cadence, CRM hygiene.

  • Interest in the nonprofit sector and a genuine curiosity about how charities raise money — direct mail, regular giving, digital, major gifts.

  • Familiarity with nonprofit CRM platforms (e.g. Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce NPSP, Blackbaud, Microsoft Dynamics) is useful but not required.

  • Experience with HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus.

Soft Skills & Qualities that make a great candidate

  • High Agency - you don’t wait to be told what to do. You see broken things and fix them.

  • Hustle - you stay in the fight when things get hard.

  • AI-First mindset - you use every tool at your disposal to move faster and think bigger.

  • Cares about the Mission - you genuinely care about helping nonprofits raise more money to change the world.


Contract Details

Contract type:

Permanent, full-time. Employed by Dataro Limited (UK).

Start date:

1 November 2026.

Location:

United Kingdom. The role is remote, with occasional travel to London for team meetings and to in-person client or sector events as needed.

Salary Range:

£37,000-£40,000 base salary based on location and experience, plus commission

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Agon

Agon is building Europe’s defence AI lab. We develop the sovereign infrastructure and AI foundation models to train, test and evolve autonomous defence systems, in Europe and for Europe. At the heart of it is a synthetic battlefield: a virtual testing ground where drones, vessels and other autonomous systems face adaptive adversaries at scale, and where their failure modes are exposed before they ever deploy. We work as a neutral partner to defence manufacturers and governments.

Founded in London in January 2026, we’ve raised $100M to date. Our $70M Series A, at a $450M valuation, was led by Northzone alongside Lakestar, Lux Capital and XYZ, with backing from former Sequoia Capital head Roelof Botha. It was also the first joint investment by the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Fund and the National Security Strategic Investment Fund.

Between them, our founders have helped build one of the defining defence-tech companies of the last decade, and started an aerospace company from scratch. Around them is a founding team hand-picked from Europe’s best engineers, each at the top of their field, and brought together to build this. We’re scaling fast across our offices in London and Berlin.

The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll be the technical bridge between Agon’s AI development environment and our customers’ real-world model development workflows. You’ll work in small teams and own end-to-end delivery of high-stakes projects.

You’ll embed with customers, working in their models, data and pipelines, and integrate our platform so their teams can build, simulate and validate AI systems at scale. Using our fast-evolving product suite, you’ll stand up in days a development environment that would take customers years to build in-house.

Our FDEs come in different flavours. Some are strongest in software integration, others in modelling and simulation or AI. Every FDE works directly with customers, writes production software and builds a strong understanding of the defence domain. If you’re strong in software and with customers but new to defence, we’d still like to hear from you.

This role is based in London, with regular travel to customer sites and our Berlin office, mainly within Europe.

What you’ll do

  • Deploy and integrate: work directly with customers to deploy and operationalise Agon’s AI development environment, connecting it to their models, data sources and pipelines.

  • Solve broad technical problems: tackle software engineering, simulation and synthetic-data pipelines, ML workflows, cloud infrastructure and system deployment.

  • Bridge systems: connect customer-built systems to Agon’s platform to deliver real value quickly.

  • Build repeatable approaches: design architectures and ways of working that make customer projects consistent and scalable.

  • Own outcomes: drive projects to completion, adapting as requirements and priorities change.

  • Be the voice of the customer: feed real-world friction and needs back to our product and engineering teams.

What you’ll bring

  • A strong engineering background: ideally in computer science, robotics or a related discipline.

  • Production software skills: proficiency in Python and at least one other production language, such as C++, Go, Java or TypeScript.

  • Integration experience: you’ve helped integrate and deploy complex systems.

  • Familiarity with AI and ML workflows: ideally including simulation, synthetic data, or model testing and validation.

  • Customer focus: excellent communication, and experience driving customer engagements to success.

  • Independence: you solve problems well and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • The right attitude: your references would describe you as low-ego, highly motivated, thoughtfully opinionated, a strong communicator and a curious listener.

  • Willingness to travel: to work on site with customers and between our offices, mainly within Europe.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering or field engineering role

  • Aerospace or defence experience

  • Deep expertise in modelling and simulation, or in AI, ML or optimisation such as reinforcement learning

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), containers and CI/CD

  • Experience with data engineering, MLOps or integrations with third-party systems

What we offer

We pay at the top of the market we compete in, and everyone is an owner.

  • Pay: salary at the 90th percentile of the companies we compete with, benchmarked by role, level and location.

  • Equity: every permanent employee holds options. New hires receive options worth their base salary, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff.

  • Cash and equity choice: trade some salary for more options, or some options for more cash.

  • Pension: 5% employer and 5% employee contributions on full base salary.

  • Real impact: you’ll shape how Agon works with customers while our FDE team is still small.

How we work

Our values shape how we work: All as One Company, Take Extreme Ownership, Low Ego, Be Bold, and Remember Who We Serve. We prefer clear written thinking to polished slides, and we hold a high bar.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you’re excited by this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still like to hear from you.

title: Music Community Ambassador | First Chair Programme
description:
Help shape the future of music teaching in London

Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair, Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London.

We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice.

You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week.

About Matchspace Music

Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place.

Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London.

What you’ll do

As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll:

  • Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks.

  • Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice.

  • Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team.

  • Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch.

  • Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community.

This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week, starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments.

What you’ll bring

We’d like to hear from musicians who:

  • Are actively connected to London’s music community.

  • Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works.

  • Enjoy meeting people and feel comfortable starting conversations.

  • Can share thoughtful, constructive feedback.

  • Want to help shape how we launch in London.

  • Can commit four hours per week for six months.

A student or recent graduate of a London conservatoire, we’re starting conversations at RAM, RCM, Guildhall and Trinity Laban, and welcome ambitious musicians from across the city, in any discipline: strings, piano, voice, jazz, composition and beyond.

What you’ll get

  • Paid participation: £25 per hour.

  • Flexible scheduling around your studies or other commitments.

  • Direct access to the founder and opportunities to contribute to product discussions.

  • A voice in the UK launch, helping us understand and respond to musicians’ needs.

  • Lasting recognition as a founding ambassador.

  • A dedicated contact: Fanny Chelle, musician, teacher and Customer Success Specialist, who will welcome you and guide you through the programme.

title: Mechatronics Engineer Intern - Automated UAV Calibration
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Mechatronics Engineer Intern on the Flight Autonomy team, you will design and program an automated calibration bench for the sensors on our autonomous systems. You will own the full chain: moving the sensors with a robotic arm, capturing data, computing calibrations and loading them onto the system. The bench will be replicated for production, so it must be reliable, documented and usable without you. This internship may lead to a full-time position.

Responsibilities

  • Learn our robotic systems, onboard sensors and current calibration process before building on it.

  • Develop sensor calibration workflows for sensors like IMUs, cameras and magnetometers.

  • Program the robotic arm to move sensors through repeatable, automated calibration sequences.

  • Build automated data capture, processing and reporting that produce calibration files ready to load.

  • Design and make mounts, fixtures and calibration targets for the bench.

  • Collect and analyse sensor data on the bench and on real systems to validate results.

  • Document the bench so sensor engineers can run it on their own and it can be replicated for production.

  • Work closely with sensor and navigation engineers and review progress regularly with your supervisor.

Candidate Requirements

  • Final-year Master’s or engineering school student in robotics, computer science, mechatronics, microengineering or a related field.

  • Clean, well-structured Python; C++ is a plus.

  • Experience automating the processing of sensor or measurement data.

  • Working knowledge of camera models and IMUs, or hands-on experience calibrating a sensor.

  • Experience designing simple mechanical parts such as mounts and fixtures and getting them made.

  • Experience building test setups that give repeatable results, and debugging them methodically.

  • Experience on a drone, Formula Student, rocketry or robotics student team is a plus.

  • Hands-on, autonomous and rigorous, with a track record of building things that work.

 

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
